import Std

namespace Dada.Common

-- A finite ordered list of entries with no duplicate keys.
structure FiniteMap (Key Value : Type) where
  entries : List (Key × Value)
  uniqueKeys : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup

def FiniteMap.empty : FiniteMap Key Value where
  entries := []
  uniqueKeys := List.nodup_nil

theorem FiniteMap.value_unique (map : FiniteMap Key Value)
    {key : Key} {value value' : Value}
    (member : (key, value) ∈ map.entries)
    (member' : (key, value') ∈ map.entries) : value = value' := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, entry⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem member
  obtain ⟨j, hj, entry'⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem member'
  have same_index : i = j := map.uniqueKeys.eq_of_getElem_eq
    (by simpa using hi) (by simpa using hj) (by simp [entry, entry'])
  subst j
  have same_entry : (key, value) = (key, value') := entry.symm.trans entry'
  exact (Prod.mk.inj same_entry).2

end Dada.Common

import Common.FiniteMap

open Dada.Common

-- ANCHOR: empty_map
example : (FiniteMap.empty : FiniteMap Nat Nat).entries = [] := by
  rfl
-- ANCHOR_END: empty_map

import Std

namespace Dada.Common

-- A graph is rooted when a node is reached from a root by finitely many edges.
inductive Rooted {Node : Type} (root : Node → Prop) (edge : Node → Node → Prop) :
    Node → Prop where
  | root (atRoot : root node) : Rooted root edge node
  | field (parent : Rooted root edge node) (stored : edge node target) :
      Rooted root edge target

-- If every allocated node has an owner, following owners backwards must reach a
-- root: each backwards field edge strictly increases a bounded allocation rank.
theorem rooted_of_covered {Node : Type} {root : Node → Prop}
    {edge : Node → Node → Prop} {allocated : Node → Prop}
    (rank : Node → Nat) (bound : Nat)
    (bounded : ∀ node, allocated node → rank node < bound)
    (covered : ∀ node, allocated node →
      root node ∨ ∃ parent, allocated parent ∧ edge parent node)
    (descending : ∀ parent node, allocated parent → edge parent node →
      rank node < rank parent) :
    ∀ node, allocated node → Rooted root edge node := by
  have byDistance : ∀ distance node, bound - rank node = distance →
      allocated node → Rooted root edge node := by
    intro distance
    induction distance using Nat.strongRecOn with
    | ind distance ih =>
      intro node measure live
      rcases covered node live with atRoot | ⟨parent, parentLive, stored⟩
      · exact .root atRoot
      · have parentBound := bounded parent parentLive
        have decrease := descending parent node parentLive stored
        have smaller : bound - rank parent < distance := by omega
        exact .field (ih (bound - rank parent) smaller parent rfl parentLive) stored
  intro node live
  exact byDistance (bound - rank node) node rfl live

end Dada.Common

import Unique.Step
import Shared.Step

namespace Dada.Correspondence

def embedId (object : Unique.ObjectId) : Shared.ObjectId := ⟨object.index⟩
def eraseId (object : Shared.ObjectId) : Unique.ObjectId := ⟨object.index⟩

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_id (object : Unique.ObjectId) : eraseId (embedId object) = object := rfl
@[simp] theorem embed_erase_id (object : Shared.ObjectId) : embedId (eraseId object) = object := rfl
@[simp] theorem embed_id_inj {a b : Unique.ObjectId} : embedId a = embedId b ↔ a = b := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => congrArg eraseId h
  · exact congrArg embedId

def embedReference (object : Unique.ObjectId) : Shared.Reference := .owned (embedId object)
def eraseReference (reference : Shared.Reference) : Unique.ObjectId := eraseId reference.object

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_reference (object : Unique.ObjectId) :
    eraseReference (embedReference object) = object := rfl

def embedSlots {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Unique.Slot)) : List (Key × Shared.Slot) :=
  slots.map (fun entry => (entry.1, entry.2.map embedReference))

def eraseSlots {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Shared.Slot)) : List (Key × Unique.Slot) :=
  slots.map (fun entry => (entry.1, entry.2.map eraseReference))

def embedObject (object : Unique.Object) : Shared.Object :=
  ⟨object.className, embedSlots object.fields⟩

def eraseObject (object : Shared.Object) : Unique.Object :=
  ⟨object.className, eraseSlots object.fields⟩

def embedState (state : Unique.State) : Shared.State :=
  ⟨state.objects.map (fun entry => (embedId entry.1, embedObject entry.2)),
    embedSlots state.variables, state.nextId⟩

def eraseState (state : Shared.State) : Unique.State :=
  ⟨state.objects.map (fun entry => (eraseId entry.1, eraseObject entry.2)),
    eraseSlots state.variables, state.nextId⟩

def embedPlace : Unique.Place → Shared.Place
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .field base name => .field (embedPlace base) name

def erasePlace : Shared.Place → Unique.Place
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .field base name => .field (erasePlace base) name

def embedStorage : Unique.StoragePlace → Shared.StoragePlace
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .field object name => .field (embedId object) name

def eraseStorage : Shared.StoragePlace → Unique.StoragePlace
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .field object name => .field (eraseId object) name

def embedValue : Unique.Value → Shared.Value
  | .give source => .give (embedPlace source)
  | .new name arguments => .new name (arguments.map embedValue)

def embedStatement (statement : Unique.Statement) : Shared.Statement :=
  ⟨statement.destination, embedValue statement.value⟩

def embedClasses (classes : Unique.Classes) : Shared.Classes :=
  classes.map (fun entry => (entry.1, ⟨entry.2.fields, .classType⟩))

def embedProgram (program : Unique.Program) : Shared.Program :=
  ⟨embedClasses program.classes, program.body.map embedStatement⟩

def embedConfiguration (configuration : Unique.Configuration) : Shared.Configuration :=
  ⟨embedState configuration.state, configuration.code.map embedStatement⟩

section Proofs

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_slots {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Unique.Slot)) :
    eraseSlots (embedSlots slots) = slots := by
  induction slots with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key, slot⟩
    cases slot <;> simpa [embedSlots, eraseSlots, embedReference, eraseReference, embedId, eraseId, Shared.Reference.owned] using ih

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_state (state : Unique.State) : eraseState (embedState state) = state := by
  cases state
  simp [eraseState, embedState, eraseObject, embedObject, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_place (place : Unique.Place) : erasePlace (embedPlace place) = place := by
  induction place with
  | «variable» => rfl
  | field base name ih => simp [embedPlace, erasePlace, ih]

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_storage (place : Unique.StoragePlace) :
    eraseStorage (embedStorage place) = place := by cases place <;> rfl

def PureSlots {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Shared.Slot)) : Prop :=
  ∀ key reference, (key, some reference) ∈ slots → reference.mode = .unique

def Pure (state : Shared.State) : Prop :=
  PureSlots state.variables ∧
    ∀ object data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects → PureSlots data.fields

@[simp] theorem pure_slots_append {Key : Type} (left right : List (Key × Shared.Slot)) :
    PureSlots (left ++ right) ↔ PureSlots left ∧ PureSlots right := by
  simp [PureSlots, List.mem_append, or_imp, forall_and]

@[simp] theorem pure_slots_cons {Key : Type} (key : Key) (slot : Shared.Slot)
    (rest : List (Key × Shared.Slot)) :
    PureSlots ((key, slot) :: rest) ↔
      (∀ reference, slot = some reference → reference.mode = .unique) ∧ PureSlots rest := by
  simp only [PureSlots, List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun reference equal => h key reference (Or.inl ⟨rfl, equal.symm⟩),
      fun key reference member => h key reference (Or.inr member)⟩
  · rintro ⟨head, tail⟩ key reference (⟨rfl, equal⟩ | member)
    · exact head reference equal.symm
    · exact tail key reference member

theorem embed_slots_pure {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Unique.Slot)) :
    PureSlots (embedSlots slots) := by
  intro key reference member
  obtain ⟨⟨oldKey, oldSlot⟩, _, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  cases oldSlot <;> simp_all [embedReference, Shared.Reference.owned]
  grind

theorem embed_pure (state : Unique.State) : Pure (embedState state) := by
  constructor
  · exact embed_slots_pure _
  · intro object data member
    obtain ⟨⟨id, old⟩, _, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    cases equal
    exact embed_slots_pure _

theorem pure_slots_roundtrip {Key : Type} {slots : List (Key × Shared.Slot)} (pure : PureSlots slots) :
    embedSlots (eraseSlots slots) = slots := by
  induction slots with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key, slot⟩
    have parts := (pure_slots_cons key slot rest).mp pure
    cases slot with
    | none => simpa [embedSlots, eraseSlots] using ih parts.2
    | some reference =>
      cases reference with
      | reference mode object =>
        have modeEq := parts.1 ⟨mode, object⟩ rfl
        cases modeEq
        simpa [embedSlots, eraseSlots, embedReference, eraseReference, embedId, eraseId, Shared.Reference.owned] using ih parts.2

theorem pure_roundtrip (pure : Pure state) : embedState (eraseState state) = state := by
  cases state with
  | mk objects variables next =>
    simp only [embedState, eraseState, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
    congr 1
    · conv => rhs; rw [← List.map_id objects]
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro entry member
      have roundtrip := pure_slots_roundtrip (pure.2 entry.1 entry.2 member)
      rcases entry with ⟨id, ⟨name, fields⟩⟩
      simpa [embedObject, eraseObject] using congrArg (fun fs => (id, Shared.Object.mk name fs)) roundtrip
    · exact pure_slots_roundtrip pure.1

theorem resolve_erase (resolved : Shared.Resolve state path source object mode) :
    Unique.Resolve (eraseState state) (erasePlace path) (eraseStorage source) (eraseId object) := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored =>
    apply Unique.Resolve.variable
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩
  | field base allocated stored ih =>
    apply Unique.Resolve.field ih (data := eraseObject _)
    · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), allocated, rfl⟩
    · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩

theorem resolve_pure (pure : Pure state)
    (resolved : Shared.Resolve state path source object mode) : mode = .unique := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored => exact pure.1 _ _ stored
  | field base allocated stored ih =>
    rw [ih, pure.2 _ _ allocated _ _ stored]
    rfl

theorem take_erase (taken : Shared.Take before source object after) :
    Unique.Take (eraseState before) (eraseStorage source) (eraseId object) (eraseState after) := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    simpa [eraseState, eraseSlots, eraseStorage, eraseReference, Shared.Reference.owned] using
      Unique.Take.variable (objects.map (fun e => (eraseId e.1, eraseObject e.2))) next
        (eraseSlots leading) (eraseSlots suffix) name (eraseId object)
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    simpa [eraseState, eraseSlots, eraseObject, eraseStorage, eraseReference, Shared.Reference.owned] using
      Unique.Take.field (eraseSlots variables) next
        (before.map (fun e => (eraseId e.1, eraseObject e.2)))
        (after.map (fun e => (eraseId e.1, eraseObject e.2))) (eraseId parent) className
        (eraseSlots leading) (eraseSlots suffix) name (eraseId object)

theorem take_pure (pure : Pure before) (taken : Shared.Take before source object after) :
    Pure after := by
  cases taken <;> simp_all [Pure, PureSlots, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons,
    Shared.Reference.owned, or_imp, forall_and] <;> grind

theorem resolve_forward (resolved : Unique.Resolve state path source object) :
    Shared.Resolve (embedState state) (embedPlace path) (embedStorage source) (embedId object) .unique := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored =>
    exact Shared.Resolve.variable (reference := embedReference _) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field base allocated stored ih =>
    exact Shared.Resolve.field (reference := embedReference _) ih
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), allocated, rfl⟩) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩)

theorem take_forward (taken : Unique.Take before source object after) :
    Shared.Take (embedState before) (embedStorage source) (embedId object) (embedState after) := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    simpa [embedState, embedSlots, embedStorage, embedReference] using
      Shared.Take.variable (objects.map (fun e => (embedId e.1, embedObject e.2))) next
        (embedSlots leading) (embedSlots suffix) name (embedId object)
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    simpa [embedState, embedSlots, embedObject, embedStorage, embedReference] using
      Shared.Take.field (embedSlots variables) next
        (before.map (fun e => (embedId e.1, embedObject e.2)))
        (after.map (fun e => (embedId e.1, embedObject e.2))) (embedId parent) className
        (embedSlots leading) (embedSlots suffix) name (embedId object)

@[simp] theorem embed_slots_keys {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Unique.Slot)) :
    (embedSlots slots).map Prod.fst = slots.map Prod.fst := by
  simp [embedSlots, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] theorem embed_bind (state : Unique.State) (name : Unique.VariableId) (object : Unique.ObjectId) :
    embedState (state.bind name object) = (embedState state).bind name (embedReference object) := by
  rfl

@[simp] theorem erase_bind (state : Shared.State) (name : Shared.VariableId) (reference : Shared.Reference) :
    eraseState (state.bind name reference) = (eraseState state).bind name (eraseReference reference) := by
  rfl

theorem embed_fields (fields : List String) (objects : List Unique.ObjectId) :
    embedSlots (fields.zip (objects.map some)) =
      fields.zip ((objects.map embedReference).map some) := by
  induction fields generalizing objects with
  | nil => simp [embedSlots]
  | cons field fields ih =>
    cases objects with
    | nil => simp [embedSlots]
    | cons object objects => simpa [embedSlots] using ih objects

@[simp] theorem embed_allocate (state : Unique.State) (className : String)
    (fields : List String) (objects : List Unique.ObjectId) :
    embedState (state.allocate className fields objects) =
      (embedState state).allocate className fields (objects.map embedReference) := by
  simp [embedState, Unique.State.allocate, Shared.State.allocate, embedObject, embed_fields, embedId]

@[simp] theorem embed_nextId (state : Unique.State) :
    (embedState state).nextId = state.nextId := rfl

@[simp] theorem embed_object_fresh (state : Unique.State) :
    Shared.ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ (embedState state).objects.map Prod.fst ↔
      Unique.ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ state.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  have keys : (embedState state).objects.map Prod.fst =
      (state.objects.map Prod.fst).map embedId := by
    simp [embedState, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
  change embedId ⟨state.nextId⟩ ∉ _ ↔ _
  rw [keys]
  simp only [List.mem_map, embed_id_inj, exists_eq_right]

-- Giving from an embedded graph cannot take either shared-copy case.
theorem give_backward (given : Shared.Give (embedState state) (embedPlace path) reference after) :
    ∃ source object, Unique.Resolve state path source object ∧
      Unique.Take state source object (eraseState after) ∧
      reference = embedReference object ∧ embedState (eraseState after) = after := by
  cases given with
  | move resolved taken =>
    exact ⟨_, _, by simpa using resolve_erase resolved,
      by simpa using take_erase taken, rfl, pure_roundtrip (take_pure (embed_pure _) taken)⟩
  | copy resolved stored => cases resolve_pure (embed_pure _) resolved
  | promote resolved promoted => cases resolve_pure (embed_pure _) resolved

theorem eval_forward (evaluated : Unique.Eval classes before value after object) :
    Shared.Eval (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (embedValue value)
      (embedState after) (embedReference object) := by
  induction evaluated using Unique.Eval.rec
      (motive_2 := fun before values after objects _ =>
        Shared.EvalArgs (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (values.map embedValue)
          (embedState after) (objects.map embedReference)) with
  | give resolved taken =>
    simpa only [embedValue, embedReference] using
      Shared.Eval.give (classes := embedClasses classes)
        (Shared.Give.move (resolve_forward resolved) (take_forward taken))
  | @new state evaluated className declaration arguments objects declared args lengths fresh ih =>
    simpa only [embedValue, embed_allocate, embedReference, embedId, embedClasses, embed_nextId, Shared.Kind.mode, Shared.Reference.owned] using
      Shared.Eval.new (declaration := ⟨declaration.fields, .classType⟩)
        (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), declared, rfl⟩)
        ih (by simpa using lengths) ((embed_object_fresh evaluated).mpr fresh) (by simp [Shared.StructArguments, Shared.Kind.isStruct])
  | nil state => exact Shared.EvalArgs.nil (embedState state)
  | cons first rest firstIH restIH => exact Shared.EvalArgs.cons firstIH restIH

theorem eval_args_forward (evaluated : Unique.EvalArgs classes before values after objects) :
    Shared.EvalArgs (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (values.map embedValue)
      (embedState after) (objects.map embedReference) := by
  induction values generalizing before after objects with
  | nil => cases evaluated; exact Shared.EvalArgs.nil _
  | cons argument arguments ih =>
    cases evaluated with
    | cons first rest => exact Shared.EvalArgs.cons (eval_forward first) (ih rest)

-- Reflection starts with an arbitrary Shared result. Pure input syntax and
-- storage force both its value and its resulting storage back into the image.
private theorem eval_backward_aux
    (evaluated : Shared.Eval (embedClasses classes) before value after reference) :
    ∀ original expression, before = embedState original → value = embedValue expression →
      ∃ result object, Unique.Eval classes original expression result object ∧
        after = embedState result ∧ reference = embedReference object := by
  induction evaluated using Shared.Eval.rec
      (motive_2 := fun before values after references _ =>
        ∀ original expressions, before = embedState original → values = expressions.map embedValue →
          ∃ result objects, Unique.EvalArgs classes original expressions result objects ∧
            after = embedState result ∧ references = objects.map embedReference) with
  | give given =>
    intro original expression beforeEq valueEq
    subst beforeEq
    cases expression with
    | give path =>
      simp only [embedValue, Shared.Value.give.injEq] at valueEq
      subst valueEq
      obtain ⟨source, object, resolved, taken, resultEq, roundtrip⟩ := give_backward given
      exact ⟨_, object, Unique.Eval.give resolved taken, roundtrip.symm, resultEq⟩
    | new name arguments => simp [embedValue] at valueEq
  | giveShare given _ =>
    intro original expression beforeEq valueEq
    cases expression <;> simp [embedValue] at valueEq
  | @new state evaluated className declaration arguments references declared args lengths fresh _ ih =>
    intro original expression beforeEq valueEq
    cases expression with
    | give path => simp [embedValue] at valueEq
    | new originalName originalArguments =>
      simp only [embedValue, Shared.Value.new.injEq] at valueEq
      obtain ⟨nameEq, argumentsEq⟩ := valueEq
      subst nameEq
      obtain ⟨result, objects, originalArgs, resultEq, referencesEq⟩ :=
        ih original originalArguments beforeEq argumentsEq
      subst resultEq
      subst referencesEq
      obtain ⟨⟨oldName, oldDeclaration⟩, originalDeclared, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp declared
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at same
      rcases same with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨result.allocate oldName oldDeclaration.fields objects, ⟨result.nextId⟩,
        Unique.Eval.new originalDeclared originalArgs (by simpa using lengths)
          ((embed_object_fresh result).mp fresh), ?_, rfl⟩
      exact (embed_allocate result oldName oldDeclaration.fields objects).symm
  | nil state =>
    rename_i original expressions beforeEq valuesEq
    cases expressions with
    | nil => exact ⟨original, [], Unique.EvalArgs.nil original, beforeEq, rfl⟩
    | cons head tail => simp at valuesEq
  | cons first rest firstIH restIH =>
    rename_i original expressions beforeEq valuesEq
    cases expressions with
    | nil => simp at valuesEq
    | cons expression expressions =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at valuesEq
      obtain ⟨middle, object, originalFirst, middleEq, objectEq⟩ :=
        firstIH original expression beforeEq valuesEq.1
      obtain ⟨result, objects, originalRest, resultEq, objectsEq⟩ :=
        restIH middle expressions middleEq valuesEq.2
      exact ⟨result, object :: objects, Unique.EvalArgs.cons originalFirst originalRest,
        resultEq, by simp [objectEq, objectsEq]⟩

theorem eval_backward
    (evaluated : Shared.Eval (embedClasses classes) (embedState before)
      (embedValue value) after reference) :
    ∃ result object, Unique.Eval classes before value result object ∧
      after = embedState result ∧ reference = embedReference object :=
  eval_backward_aux evaluated before value rfl rfl

theorem eval_args_backward
    (evaluated : Shared.EvalArgs (embedClasses classes) (embedState before)
      (values.map embedValue) after references) :
    ∃ result objects, Unique.EvalArgs classes before values result objects ∧
      after = embedState result ∧ references = objects.map embedReference := by
  induction values generalizing before after references with
  | nil =>
    cases evaluated
    exact ⟨before, [], Unique.EvalArgs.nil before, rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons argument arguments ih =>
    cases evaluated with
    | cons first rest =>
      obtain ⟨middle, object, originalFirst, middleEq, referenceEq⟩ := eval_backward first
      rw [middleEq] at rest
      obtain ⟨result, objects, originalRest, resultEq, referencesEq⟩ := ih rest
      exact ⟨result, object :: objects, Unique.EvalArgs.cons originalFirst originalRest,
        resultEq, by simp [referenceEq, referencesEq]⟩

theorem eval_correspondence :
    Shared.Eval (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (embedValue value) after reference ↔
      ∃ result object, Unique.Eval classes before value result object ∧
        after = embedState result ∧ reference = embedReference object := by
  constructor
  · exact eval_backward
  · rintro ⟨result, object, evaluated, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact eval_forward evaluated

theorem eval_args_correspondence :
    Shared.EvalArgs (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (values.map embedValue) after references ↔
      ∃ result objects, Unique.EvalArgs classes before values result objects ∧
        after = embedState result ∧ references = objects.map embedReference := by
  constructor
  · exact eval_args_backward
  · rintro ⟨result, objects, evaluated, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact eval_args_forward evaluated

theorem step_forward (step : Unique.Step classes before after) :
    Shared.Step (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) (embedConfiguration after) := by
  cases step with
  | letValue fresh evaluated =>
    simpa only [embedConfiguration, List.map_cons, embedStatement, embed_bind] using
      Shared.Step.letValue (by simpa only [embedState, embed_slots_keys] using fresh)
        (eval_forward evaluated)

-- The quantified successor is arbitrary, not assumed to be an embedding.
theorem step_backward (step : Shared.Step (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) after) :
    ∃ successor, Unique.Step classes before successor ∧ after = embedConfiguration successor := by
  rcases before with ⟨state, code⟩
  cases code with
  | nil => cases step
  | cons statement rest =>
    rcases statement with ⟨destination, value⟩
    change Shared.Step _ ⟨embedState state,
      ⟨destination, embedValue value⟩ :: rest.map embedStatement⟩ after at step
    cases step with
    | letValue fresh evaluated =>
      obtain ⟨result, object, original, resultEq, referenceEq⟩ := eval_backward evaluated
      subst resultEq
      subst referenceEq
      refine ⟨⟨result.bind destination object, rest⟩,
        Unique.Step.letValue (by simpa only [embedState, embed_slots_keys] using fresh) original, ?_⟩
      simp only [embedConfiguration, embed_bind]

-- The embedding preserves the complete program, including its remaining code.
theorem initial_correspondence (program : Unique.Program) :
    embedConfiguration (Unique.Configuration.initial program) =
      Shared.Configuration.initial (embedProgram program) := by rfl

theorem finished_correspondence (configuration : Unique.Configuration) :
    (embedConfiguration configuration).finished ↔ configuration.finished := by
  simp [Shared.Configuration.finished, Unique.Configuration.finished, embedConfiguration]


theorem stuck_correspondence (classes : Unique.Classes) (configuration : Unique.Configuration) :
    Shared.Stuck (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration configuration) ↔
      Unique.Stuck classes configuration := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨unfinished, noStep⟩
    refine ⟨fun finished => unfinished ((finished_correspondence _).mpr finished), ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨after, step⟩
    exact noStep ⟨_, step_forward step⟩
  · rintro ⟨unfinished, noStep⟩
    refine ⟨fun finished => unfinished ((finished_correspondence _).mp finished), ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨after, step⟩
    obtain ⟨successor, original, _⟩ := step_backward step
    exact noStep ⟨successor, original⟩

theorem steps_forward (steps : Unique.Steps classes before after) :
    Shared.Steps (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) (embedConfiguration after) := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact Shared.Steps.refl _
  | step first _ ih => exact Shared.Steps.step (step_forward first) ih

theorem steps_backward (steps : Shared.Steps (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) after) :
    ∃ successor, Unique.Steps classes before successor ∧ after = embedConfiguration successor := by
  generalize startEq : embedConfiguration before = start at steps
  induction steps generalizing before with
  | refl configuration => exact ⟨before, .refl before, startEq.symm⟩
  | step first rest ih =>
    rw [← startEq] at first
    obtain ⟨middle, original, same⟩ := step_backward first
    obtain ⟨last, suffix, final⟩ := ih same.symm
    exact ⟨last, .step original suffix, final⟩

-- One-step bisimulation of the image of the unique language.
theorem step_correspondence :
    Shared.Step (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) after ↔
      ∃ successor, Unique.Step classes before successor ∧ after = embedConfiguration successor := by
  constructor
  · exact step_backward
  · rintro ⟨successor, original, rfl⟩
    exact step_forward original

theorem steps_correspondence :
    Shared.Steps (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) after ↔
      ∃ successor, Unique.Steps classes before successor ∧ after = embedConfiguration successor := by
  constructor
  · exact steps_backward
  · rintro ⟨successor, original, rfl⟩
    exact steps_forward original

-- Execution boundaries agree as well as individual transitions.
theorem boundary_correspondence (program : Unique.Program) :
    embedConfiguration (Unique.Configuration.initial program) =
      Shared.Configuration.initial (embedProgram program) ∧
    ∀ configuration : Unique.Configuration,
      ((embedConfiguration configuration).finished ↔ configuration.finished) ∧
      (Shared.Stuck (embedClasses program.classes) (embedConfiguration configuration) ↔
        Unique.Stuck program.classes configuration) :=
  ⟨initial_correspondence program,
    fun configuration => ⟨finished_correspondence configuration,
      stuck_correspondence program.classes configuration⟩⟩

end Proofs

end Dada.Correspondence

import Correspondence.UniqueSharedUnpacking
import Unique.TypingEffects
import Shared.TypingEffects
import Shared.TypingViewLemmas

namespace Dada.Correspondence.Typing

def embedType (ty : Unique.Typing.ViewType) : Shared.Typing.ValueType := ⟨.given, ty⟩

def embedClass (declaration : Unique.Typing.TypedClass) : Shared.Typing.TypedClass :=
  ⟨declaration.fields.map fun field => (field.1, ⟨.given, field.2⟩), .classType⟩

def embedClasses (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) : Shared.Typing.ClassTable :=
  classes.map fun entry => (entry.1, embedClass entry.2)

def embedEnvironment (environment : Unique.Typing.Environment) : Shared.Typing.Environment :=
  environment.map fun entry => (entry.1, entry.2.map embedType)

def eraseEnvironment (environment : Shared.Typing.Environment) : Unique.Typing.Environment :=
  environment.map fun entry => (entry.1, entry.2.map Shared.Typing.ValueType.nominal)

@[simp] theorem nominal_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) :
    (embedClasses classes).nominal = classes := by
  simp only [embedClasses, Shared.Typing.ClassTable.nominal, List.map_map]
  conv => rhs; rw [← List.map_id classes]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro entry _
  rcases entry with ⟨name, ⟨fields⟩⟩
  simp [embedClass, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_classes (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) :
    (embedClasses classes).erase = Dada.Correspondence.embedClasses classes.erase := by
  simp [embedClasses, embedClass, Shared.Typing.ClassTable.erase,
    Dada.Correspondence.embedClasses, Unique.Typing.ClassTable.erase,
    List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] theorem embed_classes_keys (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) :
    (embedClasses classes).map Prod.fst = classes.map Prod.fst := by
  simp [embedClasses, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] theorem embed_environment_keys (environment : Unique.Typing.Environment) :
    (embedEnvironment environment).map Prod.fst = environment.map Prod.fst := by
  simp [embedEnvironment, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_environment (environment : Unique.Typing.Environment) :
    eraseEnvironment (embedEnvironment environment) = environment := by
  simp [eraseEnvironment, embedEnvironment, embedType, List.map_map,
    Function.comp_def, Option.map_map]

private theorem lookup_map_value {Key Value Result : Type} [BEq Key]
    (entries : List (Key × Value)) (key : Key) (f : Value → Result) :
    (entries.map (fun entry => (entry.1, f entry.2))).lookup key =
      (entries.lookup key).map f := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨entryKey, entryValue⟩
    by_cases same : key == entryKey
    · simp [List.lookup_cons, same]
    · simpa [List.lookup_cons, same] using ih

@[simp] theorem lookup_embed_class (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) (name : String) :
    (embedClasses classes).lookup name = (classes.lookup name).map embedClass :=
  lookup_map_value classes name _

theorem kind_valid_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) (ty : Unique.Typing.ViewType)
    (declared : (classes.lookup ty.className).isSome = true) :
    Shared.Typing.KindValid (embedClasses classes) (embedType ty) := by
  unfold Shared.Typing.KindValid
  simp only [embedType, Shared.Typing.ValueType.base, lookup_embed_class]
  cases found : classes.lookup ty.className with
  | none => simp [found] at declared
  | some declaration => simp [embedClass, Shared.Typing.kindAllows]

@[simp] theorem admissible_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable)
    (ty : Unique.Typing.ViewType) :
    Shared.Typing.Admissible (embedClasses classes) (embedType ty) ↔
      Unique.Typing.Admissible classes ty := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by simpa [Shared.Typing.ValueType.WellFormed, embedType] using h.1.1,
      by simpa [Shared.Typing.Normalized, embedType] using h.2⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨⟨by simpa [embedType] using h.1, kind_valid_embed classes ty h.1.1⟩,
      by simpa [Shared.Typing.Normalized, embedType] using h.2⟩

@[simp] theorem environment_wellFormed_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable)
    (environment : Unique.Typing.Environment) :
    (embedEnvironment environment).WellFormed (embedClasses classes) ↔
      environment.WellFormed classes := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨keys, entries⟩
    refine ⟨by simpa using keys, List.all_eq_true.mpr ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨name, slot⟩ member
    have checked := List.all_eq_true.mp entries (name, slot.map embedType)
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, slot), member, rfl⟩)
    cases slot with
    | none => rfl
    | some ty =>
      exact decide_eq_true ((admissible_embed classes ty).mp (of_decide_eq_true checked))
  · rintro ⟨keys, entries⟩
    refine ⟨by simpa using keys, List.all_eq_true.mpr ?_⟩
    intro entry member
    change entry ∈ environment.map (fun entry => (entry.1, entry.2.map embedType)) at member
    obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, originalMember, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    have checked := List.all_eq_true.mp entries (name, slot) originalMember
    cases slot with
    | none => rfl
    | some ty =>
      exact decide_eq_true ((admissible_embed classes ty).mpr (of_decide_eq_true checked))

@[simp] theorem splitPlace_embed (place : Unique.Place) :
    Shared.Typing.splitPlace (embedPlace place) = Unique.Typing.splitPlace place := by
  induction place with
  | «variable» => rfl
  | field base name ih => simp [Shared.Typing.splitPlace, Unique.Typing.splitPlace, embedPlace, ih]

@[simp] theorem lookup_embed_field (declaration : Unique.Typing.TypedClass) (name : String) :
    (embedClass declaration).fields.lookup name =
      (declaration.fields.lookup name).map (fun target => (⟨.given, target⟩ : Shared.Typing.FieldType)) :=
  lookup_map_value declaration.fields name _

theorem declaredPermission_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) (name : String)
    (path : Unique.Typing.Path) :
    Shared.Typing.declaredPermission (embedClasses classes) name path =
      (Unique.Typing.classAt classes name path).map (fun _ => Shared.Typing.Perm.given) := by
  induction path generalizing name with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases found : classes.lookup name with
    | none => simp [Shared.Typing.declaredPermission, Unique.Typing.classAt, found]
    | some declaration =>
      cases fieldFound : declaration.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp [Shared.Typing.declaredPermission, Unique.Typing.classAt, found, fieldFound]
      | some target =>
        simp [Shared.Typing.declaredPermission, Unique.Typing.classAt, found, fieldFound, ih,
          Shared.Typing.Perm.comp_given_left]

theorem focus_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) (ty : Unique.Typing.ViewType)
    (path : Unique.Typing.Path) :
    Shared.Typing.focus (embedClasses classes) (embedType ty) path =
      (Unique.Typing.focus classes ty path).map embedType := by
  cases atClass : Unique.Typing.classAt classes ty.className path with
  | none =>
    have noFocus : Unique.Typing.focus classes ty path = none := by
      simp [Unique.Typing.focus, Unique.Typing.normalize_className, atClass]
    simp [Shared.Typing.focus, embedType, noFocus]
  | some target =>
    simp [Shared.Typing.focus, Shared.Typing.ValueType.base, embedType,
      declaredPermission_embed, atClass, Shared.Typing.Perm.comp_given_left]
    cases Unique.Typing.focus classes ty path <;> rfl

theorem emptyPath_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) (ty : Unique.Typing.ViewType)
    (path : Unique.Typing.Path) :
    Shared.Typing.emptyPath (embedClasses classes) (embedType ty) path =
      (Unique.Typing.emptyPath classes ty path).map embedType := by
  simp only [Shared.Typing.emptyPath, embedType, nominal_embed]
  rfl

@[simp] theorem environment_lookup_embed (environment : Unique.Typing.Environment) (name : String) :
    (embedEnvironment environment).lookup name = (environment.lookup name).map (Option.map embedType) := by
  simp [Shared.Typing.Environment.lookup, Unique.Typing.Environment.lookup,
    embedEnvironment, List.find?_map, Function.comp_def, Option.map_map]

theorem environment_replace_embed (environment : Unique.Typing.Environment) (name : String)
    (description : Unique.Typing.SlotDescription) :
    (embedEnvironment environment).replace name (description.map embedType) =
      embedEnvironment (environment.replace name description) := by
  simp only [Shared.Typing.Environment.replace, Unique.Typing.Environment.replace,
    embedEnvironment, List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro entry _
  by_cases same : entry.1 = name <;> simp [same]

theorem give_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) (environment : Unique.Typing.Environment)
    (place : Unique.Place) :
    Shared.Typing.give (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment environment) (embedPlace place) =
      (Unique.Typing.take classes environment place).map
        (fun result => (embedType result.1, embedEnvironment result.2)) := by
  simp only [Shared.Typing.give, Unique.Typing.take, splitPlace_embed, environment_lookup_embed]
  cases sourceFound : environment.lookup (Unique.Typing.splitPlace place).1 with
  | none => rfl
  | some sourceSlot =>
    cases sourceSlot with
    | none => rfl
    | some source =>
      dsimp only [Option.map, Bind.bind, Option.bind]
      rw [focus_embed]
      cases focused : Unique.Typing.focus classes source (Unique.Typing.splitPlace place).2 with
      | none => rfl
      | some result =>
        dsimp only [Option.map, Bind.bind, Option.bind]
        simp only [show (embedType result).permission = .given from rfl, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte]
        by_cases empty : (Unique.Typing.splitPlace place).2 = []
        · simp [empty, ← environment_replace_embed]
        · simp only [empty, ↓reduceIte, emptyPath_embed]
          cases Unique.Typing.emptyPath classes source (Unique.Typing.splitPlace place).2 with
          | none => rfl
          | some remaining =>
            simp [← environment_replace_embed]

theorem subtype_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) (source target : Unique.Typing.ViewType) :
    Shared.Typing.Subtype (embedClasses classes) (embedType source) (embedType target) ↔
      Unique.Typing.Subtype classes source target := by
  simp [Shared.Typing.Subtype, embedType]

theorem fieldDescription_embed (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable)
    (ty : Unique.Typing.ViewType) (field : String) :
    Shared.Typing.fieldDescription (embedClasses classes) (embedType ty) field =
      (Unique.Typing.fieldDescription classes ty field).map (Option.map embedType) := by
  unfold Shared.Typing.fieldDescription Unique.Typing.fieldDescription
  change (if Unique.Typing.negative ty [field] then some none else
    (Shared.Typing.focus (embedClasses classes) (embedType ty) [field]).map some) = _
  rw [focus_embed]
  cases Unique.Typing.negative ty [field] <;> simp [Option.map_map, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] theorem embed_environment_append (left right : Unique.Typing.Environment) :
    embedEnvironment (left ++ right) = embedEnvironment left ++ embedEnvironment right := by
  simp [embedEnvironment]

@[simp] theorem embed_environment_cons (name : String) (slot : Unique.Typing.SlotDescription)
    (rest : Unique.Typing.Environment) :
    embedEnvironment ((name, slot) :: rest) = (name, slot.map embedType) :: embedEnvironment rest := rfl

theorem expression_forward
    (typed : Unique.Typing.ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    Shared.Typing.ExprTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before) (embedValue value)
      (embedType ty) (embedEnvironment after) := by
  induction typed using Unique.Typing.ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before values names after _ =>
      Shared.Typing.ArgsTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
        (values.map embedValue) (names.map fun name => ⟨.given, name⟩) (embedEnvironment after)) with
  | give beforeWf taken admissible afterWf =>
    simp only [embedValue]
    exact .give (by simpa using beforeWf) (by simp [give_embed, taken])
      (by simpa using admissible) (by simpa using afterWf)
  | @new before after name declaration arguments declared typedArgs admissible ih =>
    simp only [embedValue]
    apply Shared.Typing.ExprTyped.new (classes := embedClasses classes) (name := name)
      (declaration := embedClass declaration)
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, declaration), declared, rfl⟩)
    · simpa [embedClass, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using ih
    · exact (admissible_embed _ _).mpr admissible
    · simp [embedClass, Shared.Kind.isStruct]
  | weaken _ admissible subtype ih =>
    exact .weaken ih ((admissible_embed _ _).mpr admissible) ((subtype_embed _ _ _).mpr subtype)
  | nil wf => exact .nil (by simpa using wf)
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact .cons first rest

theorem arguments_forward
    (typed : Unique.Typing.ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    Shared.Typing.ArgsTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
      (values.map embedValue) (names.map fun name => ⟨.given, name⟩) (embedEnvironment after) := by
  induction typed using Unique.Typing.ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil wf => exact .nil (by simpa using wf)
  | cons first _ _ rest => exact .cons (expression_forward first) rest

theorem fieldBindings_forward
    (typed : Unique.Typing.FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings) :
    Shared.Typing.FieldBindings (embedClasses classes) (embedType ty) fields
      (embedEnvironment bindings) := by
  induction typed with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons field _ ih =>
    exact .cons (by simp [fieldDescription_embed, field]) ih

theorem binding_forward
    (typed : Unique.Typing.BindingTyped classes before pattern ty after) :
    Shared.Typing.BindingTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
      (Unpacking.embedPattern pattern) (embedType ty) (embedEnvironment after) := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» wf admissible fresh =>
    exact .variable (by simpa using wf) (by simpa using admissible) (by simpa using fresh)
  | @unpack ty name declaration fields bindings wf admissible base declared permutation
      distinct fresh described afterWf =>
    rw [embed_environment_append]
    apply Shared.Typing.BindingTyped.unpack (classes := embedClasses classes)
      (declaration := embedClass declaration)
      (by simpa using wf) (by simpa using admissible) rfl base
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, declaration), declared, rfl⟩)
    · simpa [embedClass, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using permutation
    · exact distinct
    · simpa using fresh
    · exact fieldBindings_forward described
    · simpa using (environment_wellFormed_embed classes (bindings ++ before)).mpr afterWf

theorem statement_forward
    (typed : Unique.Typing.StatementTyped classes before statement after) :
    Shared.Typing.StatementTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
      (Unpacking.embedStatement statement) (embedEnvironment after) := by
  cases typed with
  | letValue expression binding => exact .letValue (expression_forward expression) (binding_forward binding)

theorem sequence_forward
    (typed : Unique.Typing.SequenceTyped classes before statements after) :
    Shared.Typing.SequenceTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
      (statements.map Unpacking.embedStatement) (embedEnvironment after) := by
  induction typed with
  | nil wf => exact .nil (by simpa using wf)
  | cons first _ rest => exact .cons (statement_forward first) rest

theorem expression_reflect_general
    (typed : Shared.Typing.ExprTyped (embedClasses classes) before value ty after) :
    ∀ originalBefore originalValue,
      before = embedEnvironment originalBefore → value = embedValue originalValue →
      ∃ originalAfter, after = embedEnvironment originalAfter ∧ ty.permission = .given ∧
        Unique.Typing.ExprTyped classes originalBefore originalValue ty.nominal originalAfter := by
  induction typed using Shared.Typing.ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before values fields after _ =>
      ∀ originalBefore originalValues,
        before = embedEnvironment originalBefore → values = originalValues.map embedValue →
        ∃ originalAfter, after = embedEnvironment originalAfter ∧
          Unique.Typing.ArgsTyped classes originalBefore originalValues
            (fields.map Shared.Typing.FieldType.className) originalAfter) with
  | @give before after place ty beforeWf given admissible afterWf =>
    intro originalBefore originalValue beforeEq valueEq
    subst before
    cases originalValue with
    | new name args => simp only [embedValue] at valueEq; cases valueEq
    | give originalPlace =>
      simp only [embedValue, Shared.Value.give.injEq] at valueEq
      subst place
      rw [give_embed] at given
      obtain ⟨⟨originalType, originalAfter⟩, taken, resultEq⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp given
      cases resultEq
      exact ⟨originalAfter, rfl, rfl, .give (by simpa using beforeWf) taken
        ((admissible_embed _ _).mp admissible) (by simpa using afterWf)⟩
  | giveShare =>
    intro originalBefore originalValue _ valueEq
    cases originalValue <;> simp only [embedValue] at valueEq <;> cases valueEq
  | @new before after name declaration arguments declared typedArgs admissible _ ih =>
    intro originalBefore originalValue beforeEq valueEq
    cases originalValue with
    | give place => simp only [embedValue] at valueEq; cases valueEq
    | new originalName originalArguments =>
      simp only [embedValue, Shared.Value.new.injEq] at valueEq
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := valueEq
      change (name, declaration) ∈ classes.map
        (fun entry => (entry.1, embedClass entry.2)) at declared
      obtain ⟨⟨name, originalDeclaration⟩, originalDeclared, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp declared
      cases equal
      obtain ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, argumentsTyped⟩ := ih originalBefore originalArguments beforeEq rfl
      refine ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, rfl, ?_⟩
      apply Unique.Typing.ExprTyped.new originalDeclared
      · simpa [embedClass, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using argumentsTyped
      · exact (admissible_embed _ _).mp admissible
  | @weaken before after value ty other typed admissible subtype ih =>
    intro originalBefore originalValue beforeEq valueEq
    obtain ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, given, originalTyped⟩ := ih originalBefore originalValue beforeEq valueEq
    have otherGiven := subtype.1.symm.trans given
    refine ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, otherGiven, .weaken originalTyped ?_ ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨by simpa using admissible.1.1, by simpa [Shared.Typing.Normalized] using admissible.2⟩
    · simpa using subtype.2
  | @nil environment wf =>
    rename_i originalBefore originalValues beforeEq valuesEq
    cases originalValues with
    | cons value rest => cases valuesEq
    | nil =>
      subst environment
      exact ⟨originalBefore, rfl, .nil (by simpa using wf)⟩
  | @cons before middle after value values field fields first rest firstIH restIH =>
    rename_i originalBefore originalValues beforeEq valuesEq
    cases originalValues with
    | nil => cases valuesEq
    | cons originalValue originalValues =>
      have parts := List.cons.inj valuesEq
      obtain ⟨originalMiddle, middleEq, _, firstTyped⟩ :=
        firstIH originalBefore originalValue beforeEq parts.1
      obtain ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, restTyped⟩ :=
        restIH originalMiddle originalValues middleEq parts.2
      exact ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, .cons firstTyped restTyped⟩

theorem expression_backward
    (typed : Shared.Typing.ExprTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
      (embedValue value) (embedType ty) (embedEnvironment after)) :
    Unique.Typing.ExprTyped classes before value ty after := by
  obtain ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, _, originalTyped⟩ := expression_reflect_general typed before value rfl rfl
  have same : after = originalAfter := by
    simpa using congrArg eraseEnvironment afterEq
  subst originalAfter
  exact originalTyped

theorem expression_correspondence :
    Unique.Typing.ExprTyped classes before value ty after ↔
      Shared.Typing.ExprTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
        (embedValue value) (embedType ty) (embedEnvironment after) :=
  ⟨expression_forward, expression_backward⟩

theorem fieldBindings_reflect_general
    (typed : Shared.Typing.FieldBindings (embedClasses classes) (embedType ty) fields bindings) :
    ∃ originalBindings, bindings = embedEnvironment originalBindings ∧
      Unique.Typing.FieldBindings classes ty fields originalBindings := by
  induction typed with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl, .nil⟩
  | @cons field destination description fields bindings described rest ih =>
    rw [fieldDescription_embed] at described
    obtain ⟨originalDescription, originalDescribed, same⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp described
    obtain ⟨originalBindings, bindingsEq, originalRest⟩ := ih
    subst description bindings
    exact ⟨(destination, originalDescription) :: originalBindings, rfl,
      .cons originalDescribed originalRest⟩

theorem binding_reflect_general
    (typed : Shared.Typing.BindingTyped (embedClasses classes) before pattern ty after) :
    ∀ originalBefore originalPattern originalType,
      before = embedEnvironment originalBefore → pattern = Unpacking.embedPattern originalPattern →
      ty = embedType originalType →
      ∃ originalAfter, after = embedEnvironment originalAfter ∧
        Unique.Typing.BindingTyped classes originalBefore originalPattern originalType originalAfter := by
  cases typed with
  | @«variable» name ty wf admissible fresh =>
    intro originalBefore originalPattern originalType beforeEq patternEq typeEq
    subst before ty
    cases originalPattern with
    | unpack name fields => simp only [Unpacking.embedPattern] at patternEq; cases patternEq
    | «variable» originalName =>
      simp only [Unpacking.embedPattern, Shared.Unpacking.Pattern.variable.injEq] at patternEq
      subst name
      exact ⟨(originalName, some originalType) :: originalBefore, rfl,
        .variable (by simpa using wf) (by simpa using admissible) (by simpa using fresh)⟩
  | @unpack ty name declaration fields bindings wf admissible given base declared
      permutation distinct fresh described afterWf =>
    intro originalBefore originalPattern originalType beforeEq patternEq typeEq
    subst before ty
    cases originalPattern with
    | «variable» name => simp only [Unpacking.embedPattern] at patternEq; cases patternEq
    | unpack originalName originalFields =>
      simp only [Unpacking.embedPattern, Shared.Unpacking.Pattern.unpack.injEq] at patternEq
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := patternEq
      change (name, declaration) ∈ classes.map
        (fun entry => (entry.1, embedClass entry.2)) at declared
      obtain ⟨⟨name, originalDeclaration⟩, originalDeclared, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp declared
      cases equal
      obtain ⟨originalBindings, bindingsEq, originalDescription⟩ := fieldBindings_reflect_general described
      subst bindings
      refine ⟨originalBindings ++ originalBefore, (embed_environment_append _ _).symm, ?_⟩
      apply Unique.Typing.BindingTyped.unpack (before := originalBefore) (ty := originalType)
        (declaration := originalDeclaration)
        (by simpa using wf) ((admissible_embed _ _).mp admissible) base originalDeclared
      · simpa [embedClass, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using permutation
      · exact distinct
      · simpa using fresh
      · exact originalDescription
      · exact (environment_wellFormed_embed _ _).mp (by simpa using afterWf)

theorem binding_backward
    (typed : Shared.Typing.BindingTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
      (Unpacking.embedPattern pattern) (embedType ty) (embedEnvironment after)) :
    Unique.Typing.BindingTyped classes before pattern ty after := by
  obtain ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, original⟩ := binding_reflect_general typed before pattern ty rfl rfl rfl
  have same : after = originalAfter := by simpa using congrArg eraseEnvironment afterEq
  subst originalAfter
  exact original

theorem binding_correspondence :
    Unique.Typing.BindingTyped classes before pattern ty after ↔
      Shared.Typing.BindingTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
        (Unpacking.embedPattern pattern) (embedType ty) (embedEnvironment after) :=
  ⟨binding_forward, binding_backward⟩

theorem statement_reflect_general
    (typed : Shared.Typing.StatementTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
      (Unpacking.embedStatement statement) after) :
    ∃ originalAfter, after = embedEnvironment originalAfter ∧
      Unique.Typing.StatementTyped classes before statement originalAfter := by
  cases statement with
  | mk pattern value =>
    cases typed with
    | letValue expression binding =>
      rename_i middle ty
      obtain ⟨originalMiddle, middleEq, given, originalExpression⟩ :=
        expression_reflect_general expression before value rfl rfl
      have typeEq : ty = embedType ty.nominal := by
        cases ty with
        | mk permission nominal => simp only at given; simp [given, embedType]
      obtain ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, originalBinding⟩ := binding_reflect_general binding
        originalMiddle pattern ty.nominal middleEq rfl typeEq
      exact ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, .letValue originalExpression originalBinding⟩

theorem statement_backward
    (typed : Shared.Typing.StatementTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
      (Unpacking.embedStatement statement) (embedEnvironment after)) :
    Unique.Typing.StatementTyped classes before statement after := by
  obtain ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, original⟩ := statement_reflect_general typed
  have same : after = originalAfter := by simpa using congrArg eraseEnvironment afterEq
  subst originalAfter
  exact original

theorem statement_correspondence :
    Unique.Typing.StatementTyped classes before statement after ↔
      Shared.Typing.StatementTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
        (Unpacking.embedStatement statement) (embedEnvironment after) :=
  ⟨statement_forward, statement_backward⟩

theorem sequence_reflect_general
    (typed : Shared.Typing.SequenceTyped (embedClasses classes) before statements after) :
    ∀ originalBefore originalStatements,
      before = embedEnvironment originalBefore → statements = originalStatements.map Unpacking.embedStatement →
      ∃ originalAfter, after = embedEnvironment originalAfter ∧
        Unique.Typing.SequenceTyped classes originalBefore originalStatements originalAfter := by
  induction typed with
  | nil wf =>
    intro originalBefore originalStatements beforeEq statementsEq
    cases originalStatements with
    | cons => cases statementsEq
    | nil =>
      rw [beforeEq] at wf
      exact ⟨originalBefore, beforeEq, .nil (by simpa using wf)⟩
  | cons first rest ih =>
    intro originalBefore originalStatements beforeEq statementsEq
    cases originalStatements with
    | nil => cases statementsEq
    | cons statement statements =>
      have parts := List.cons.inj statementsEq
      rw [beforeEq, parts.1] at first
      obtain ⟨originalMiddle, middleEq, firstTyped⟩ := statement_reflect_general first
      obtain ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, restTyped⟩ := ih originalMiddle statements middleEq parts.2
      exact ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, .cons firstTyped restTyped⟩

theorem sequence_backward
    (typed : Shared.Typing.SequenceTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
      (statements.map Unpacking.embedStatement) (embedEnvironment after)) :
    Unique.Typing.SequenceTyped classes before statements after := by
  obtain ⟨originalAfter, afterEq, original⟩ := sequence_reflect_general typed before statements rfl rfl
  have same : after = originalAfter := by simpa using congrArg eraseEnvironment afterEq
  subst originalAfter
  exact original

theorem sequence_correspondence :
    Unique.Typing.SequenceTyped classes before statements after ↔
      Shared.Typing.SequenceTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
        (statements.map Unpacking.embedStatement) (embedEnvironment after) :=
  ⟨sequence_forward, sequence_backward⟩

theorem classes_wellFormed_correspondence (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) :
    (embedClasses classes).WellFormed ↔ classes.WellFormed := by
  constructor
  · intro wf
    simpa using wf.nominal
  · intro wf
    refine ⟨by simpa using wf.1, ?_⟩
    intro entry member
    change entry ∈ classes.map (fun entry => (entry.1, embedClass entry.2)) at member
    obtain ⟨⟨name, declaration⟩, declared, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [embedClass, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using (wf.2 _ declared).1
    · intro field member
      change field ∈ declaration.fields.map (fun field =>
        (field.1, (⟨.given, field.2⟩ : Shared.Typing.FieldType))) at member
      obtain ⟨⟨field, target⟩, originalMember, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
      have present := (wf.2 _ declared).2 (field, target) originalMember
      refine ⟨by simpa using present, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply kind_valid_embed classes (.whole target)
        simpa [Unique.Typing.ViewType.whole, List.lookup_isSome_iff, List.mem_map, Prod.exists] using present
      · simp [embedClass, Shared.Kind.isStruct]

theorem program_correspondence (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable)
    (statements : List Unique.Unpacking.Statement) :
    Unique.Typing.ProgramTyped classes statements ↔
      Shared.Typing.ProgramTyped (embedClasses classes) (statements.map Unpacking.embedStatement) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨classesWf, final, typed⟩
    exact ⟨(classes_wellFormed_correspondence classes).mpr classesWf,
      embedEnvironment final, sequence_forward typed⟩
  · rintro ⟨classesWf, final, typed⟩
    obtain ⟨originalFinal, _, original⟩ := sequence_reflect_general typed [] statements rfl rfl
    exact ⟨(classes_wellFormed_correspondence classes).mp classesWf, originalFinal, original⟩

-- The embedding adds given to every static type and unique to every runtime
-- reference. Backward execution quantifies over arbitrary Shared successors.
theorem given_fragment (classes : Unique.Typing.ClassTable) :
    (∀ before value ty after,
      Unique.Typing.ExprTyped classes before value ty after ↔
        Shared.Typing.ExprTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
          (embedValue value) (embedType ty) (embedEnvironment after)) ∧
    (∀ before pattern ty after,
      Unique.Typing.BindingTyped classes before pattern ty after ↔
        Shared.Typing.BindingTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
          (Unpacking.embedPattern pattern) (embedType ty) (embedEnvironment after)) ∧
    (∀ before statement after,
      Unique.Typing.StatementTyped classes before statement after ↔
        Shared.Typing.StatementTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
          (Unpacking.embedStatement statement) (embedEnvironment after)) ∧
    (∀ before statements after,
      Unique.Typing.SequenceTyped classes before statements after ↔
        Shared.Typing.SequenceTyped (embedClasses classes) (embedEnvironment before)
          (statements.map Unpacking.embedStatement) (embedEnvironment after)) ∧
    (∀ statements, Unique.Typing.ProgramTyped classes statements ↔
      Shared.Typing.ProgramTyped (embedClasses classes) (statements.map Unpacking.embedStatement)) ∧
    (∀ before after,
      Shared.Unpacking.Step (embedClasses classes).erase (Unpacking.embedConfiguration before) after ↔
        ∃ successor, Unique.Unpacking.Step classes.erase before successor ∧
          after = Unpacking.embedConfiguration successor) ∧
    (∀ before after,
      Shared.Unpacking.Steps (embedClasses classes).erase (Unpacking.embedConfiguration before) after ↔
        ∃ successor, Unique.Unpacking.Steps classes.erase before successor ∧
          after = Unpacking.embedConfiguration successor) ∧
    (∀ configuration, (Unpacking.embedConfiguration configuration).finished ↔ configuration.finished) ∧
    (∀ configuration,
      (∃ final, Shared.Unpacking.Steps (embedClasses classes).erase
        (Unpacking.embedConfiguration configuration) final ∧ final.finished) ↔
      (∃ final, Unique.Unpacking.Steps classes.erase configuration final ∧ final.finished)) := by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ _ _ => expression_correspondence,
    fun _ _ _ _ => binding_correspondence, fun _ _ _ => statement_correspondence,
    fun _ _ _ => sequence_correspondence, program_correspondence classes, ?_, ?_,
    Unpacking.finished_correspondence, ?_⟩
  · intro before after
    simpa using (Unpacking.step_correspondence (classes := classes.erase)
      (before := before) (after := after))
  · intro before after
    simpa using (Unpacking.steps_correspondence (classes := classes.erase)
      (before := before) (after := after))
  · intro configuration
    simpa using (Unpacking.completion_correspondence (classes := classes.erase) configuration)

end Dada.Correspondence.Typing

import Correspondence.UniqueShared
import Unique.Unpacking
import Shared.Unpacking

namespace Dada.Correspondence.Unpacking

def embedPattern : Unique.Unpacking.Pattern → Shared.Unpacking.Pattern
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .unpack name fields => .unpack name fields

def erasePattern : Shared.Unpacking.Pattern → Unique.Unpacking.Pattern
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .unpack name fields => .unpack name fields

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_pattern (pattern : Unique.Unpacking.Pattern) :
    erasePattern (embedPattern pattern) = pattern := by cases pattern <;> rfl

def embedStatement (statement : Unique.Unpacking.Statement) : Shared.Unpacking.Statement :=
  ⟨embedPattern statement.pattern, embedValue statement.value⟩

def embedConfiguration (configuration : Unique.Unpacking.Configuration) : Shared.Unpacking.Configuration :=
  ⟨embedState configuration.state, configuration.code.map embedStatement⟩

theorem transfer_forward (transferred : Unique.Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    Shared.Unpacking.Transfer pattern (embedSlots fields) (embedSlots bindings) := by
  induction transferred with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | @cons field name slot pattern before after bindings rest ih =>
    simpa [embedSlots] using Shared.Unpacking.Transfer.cons
      (before := embedSlots before) (after := embedSlots after) (slot := slot.map embedReference) (by simpa [embedSlots] using ih)

theorem transfer_erase (transferred : Shared.Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    Unique.Unpacking.Transfer pattern (eraseSlots fields) (eraseSlots bindings) := by
  induction transferred with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | @cons field name slot pattern before after bindings rest ih =>
    simpa [eraseSlots] using Unique.Unpacking.Transfer.cons
      (before := eraseSlots before) (after := eraseSlots after) (slot := slot.map eraseReference) (by simpa [eraseSlots] using ih)

theorem transfer_pure (transferred : Shared.Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields bindings)
    (pure : PureSlots fields) : PureSlots bindings := by
  intro name reference member
  have slotMember : some reference ∈ bindings.map Prod.snd :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), member, rfl⟩
  have fieldMember := transferred.slots.mem_iff.mp slotMember
  obtain ⟨⟨field, slot⟩, present, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp fieldMember
  dsimp at same
  subst slot
  exact pure field reference present

theorem bind_forward (binding : Unique.Unpacking.Bind classes before object pattern after) :
    Shared.Unpacking.Bind (embedClasses classes) (embedState before)
      (embedReference object) (embedPattern pattern) (embedState after) := by
  cases binding with
  | «variable» fresh =>
    exact .variable (by simpa [embedState, embed_slots_keys] using fresh)
  | @unpack before after variables nextId object className fields pattern bindings declaration
      declared shape uniqueFields uniqueNames fresh transfer =>
    simpa [embedState, embedObject, embedSlots, embedPattern, embedReference, embedClasses] using
      Shared.Unpacking.Bind.unpack
        (before := before.map fun e => (embedId e.1, embedObject e.2))
        (after := after.map fun e => (embedId e.1, embedObject e.2))
        (variables := embedSlots variables) (nextId := nextId) (object := embedId object)
        (className := className) (fields := embedSlots fields) (pattern := pattern)
        (bindings := embedSlots bindings) (declaration := ⟨declaration.fields, .classType⟩)
        (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(className, declaration), declared, rfl⟩)
        (by simpa using shape) uniqueFields uniqueNames (by simpa using fresh)
        (transfer_forward transfer)

@[simp] theorem erase_slots_keys {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Shared.Slot)) :
    (eraseSlots slots).map Prod.fst = slots.map Prod.fst := by
  simp [eraseSlots, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

theorem bind_erase (binding : Shared.Unpacking.Bind (embedClasses classes) before reference pattern after) :
    Unique.Unpacking.Bind classes (eraseState before)
      (eraseReference reference) (erasePattern pattern) (eraseState after) := by
  cases binding with
  | «variable» fresh =>
    exact .variable (by simpa [eraseState, erase_slots_keys] using fresh)
  | @unpack before after variables nextId object className fields pattern bindings declaration
      declared shape uniqueFields uniqueNames fresh transfer =>
    obtain ⟨⟨originalName, original⟩, originalDeclared, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp declared
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at same
    rcases same with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simpa [eraseState, eraseObject, eraseSlots, erasePattern, eraseReference,
        Shared.Reference.owned] using
      Unique.Unpacking.Bind.unpack
        (before := before.map fun e => (eraseId e.1, eraseObject e.2))
        (after := after.map fun e => (eraseId e.1, eraseObject e.2))
        (variables := eraseSlots variables) (nextId := nextId) (object := eraseId object)
        (className := originalName) (fields := eraseSlots fields) (pattern := pattern)
        (bindings := eraseSlots bindings) (declaration := original)
        originalDeclared (by simpa using shape) uniqueFields uniqueNames (by simpa using fresh)
        (transfer_erase transfer)

theorem bind_pure (binding : Shared.Unpacking.Bind classes before reference pattern after)
    (pure : Pure before) (unique : reference.mode = .unique) : Pure after := by
  cases binding with
  | «variable» fresh =>
    constructor
    · simpa only [Shared.State.bind, pure_slots_cons] using
        And.intro (fun other (same : some reference = some other) => by cases same; exact unique) pure.1
    · exact pure.2
  | @unpack before after variables nextId object className fields pattern bindings declaration
      declared shape uniqueFields uniqueNames fresh transfer =>
    constructor
    · rw [pure_slots_append]
      exact ⟨transfer_pure transfer (pure.2 object ⟨className, fields⟩ (by simp)), pure.1⟩
    · intro id data member
      apply pure.2 id data
      rcases List.mem_append.mp member with left | right
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ left
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ right)

theorem bind_backward
    (binding : Shared.Unpacking.Bind (embedClasses classes) (embedState before)
      (embedReference object) (embedPattern pattern) after) :
    ∃ result, Unique.Unpacking.Bind classes before object pattern result ∧
      after = embedState result := by
  exact ⟨eraseState after, by simpa using bind_erase binding,
    (pure_roundtrip (bind_pure binding (embed_pure before) rfl)).symm⟩

theorem step_forward (step : Unique.Unpacking.Step classes before after) :
    Shared.Unpacking.Step (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before)
      (embedConfiguration after) := by
  cases step with
  | letValue evaluation binding => exact .letValue (eval_forward evaluation) (bind_forward binding)

theorem step_backward
    (step : Shared.Unpacking.Step (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) after) :
    ∃ successor, Unique.Unpacking.Step classes before successor ∧ after = embedConfiguration successor := by
  rcases before with ⟨state, code⟩
  cases code with
  | nil => cases step
  | cons statement rest =>
    rcases statement with ⟨pattern, value⟩
    cases step with
    | letValue evaluation binding =>
      obtain ⟨evaluated, object, original, rfl, rfl⟩ := eval_backward evaluation
      obtain ⟨result, bound, rfl⟩ := bind_backward binding
      exact ⟨⟨result, rest⟩, .letValue original bound, rfl⟩

theorem steps_forward (trace : Unique.Unpacking.Steps classes before after) :
    Shared.Unpacking.Steps (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before)
      (embedConfiguration after) := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | step first _ rest => exact .step (step_forward first) rest

theorem steps_backward
    (trace : Shared.Unpacking.Steps (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) after) :
    ∃ successor, Unique.Unpacking.Steps classes before successor ∧ after = embedConfiguration successor := by
  generalize startEq : embedConfiguration before = start at trace
  induction trace generalizing before with
  | refl => exact ⟨before, .refl _, startEq.symm⟩
  | step first _ rest =>
    rw [← startEq] at first
    obtain ⟨middle, original, same⟩ := step_backward first
    obtain ⟨last, suffix, final⟩ := rest same.symm
    exact ⟨last, .step original suffix, final⟩

theorem step_correspondence :
    Shared.Unpacking.Step (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) after ↔
      ∃ successor, Unique.Unpacking.Step classes before successor ∧ after = embedConfiguration successor := by
  constructor
  · exact step_backward
  · rintro ⟨successor, original, rfl⟩
    exact step_forward original

theorem steps_correspondence :
    Shared.Unpacking.Steps (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) after ↔
      ∃ successor, Unique.Unpacking.Steps classes before successor ∧ after = embedConfiguration successor := by
  constructor
  · exact steps_backward
  · rintro ⟨successor, original, rfl⟩
    exact steps_forward original

theorem finished_correspondence (configuration : Unique.Unpacking.Configuration) :
    (embedConfiguration configuration).finished ↔ configuration.finished := by
  simp [Shared.Unpacking.Configuration.finished, Unique.Unpacking.Configuration.finished,
    embedConfiguration]

theorem stuck_correspondence (classes : Unique.Classes) (configuration : Unique.Unpacking.Configuration) :
    Shared.Unpacking.Stuck (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration configuration) ↔
      Unique.Unpacking.Stuck classes configuration := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨unfinished, noStep⟩
    refine ⟨fun finished => unfinished ((finished_correspondence _).mpr finished), ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨after, step⟩
    exact noStep ⟨_, step_forward step⟩
  · rintro ⟨unfinished, noStep⟩
    refine ⟨fun finished => unfinished ((finished_correspondence _).mp finished), ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨after, step⟩
    obtain ⟨successor, original, _⟩ := step_backward step
    exact noStep ⟨successor, original⟩

theorem completion_correspondence (configuration : Unique.Unpacking.Configuration) :
    (∃ final, Shared.Unpacking.Steps (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration configuration) final ∧
      final.finished) ↔
    (∃ final, Unique.Unpacking.Steps classes configuration final ∧ final.finished) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨final, trace, finished⟩
    obtain ⟨original, originalTrace, rfl⟩ := steps_backward trace
    exact ⟨original, originalTrace, (finished_correspondence original).mp finished⟩
  · rintro ⟨final, trace, finished⟩
    exact ⟨embedConfiguration final, steps_forward trace,
      (finished_correspondence final).mpr finished⟩

end Dada.Correspondence.Unpacking

-- Taking a reference never changes an object's class or field domain. Every
-- owner remaining in a field was already present in that same field.
theorem Take.object_data {before after : State} {place : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId}
    (taken : Take before place object after) (id : ObjectId) (data : Object)
    (stored : (id, data) ∈ after.objects) :
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      data.className = oldData.className ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name target, (name, some target) ∈ data.fields →
        (name, some target) ∈ oldData.fields := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading suffix name object =>
    exact ⟨data, stored, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
  | field variables nextId leadingObjects trailingObjects parent className
      leadingFields trailingFields fieldName object =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with unchanged | changed | unchanged
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ unchanged, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
    · cases changed
      refine ⟨⟨className, leadingFields ++ (fieldName, some (.owned object)) :: trailingFields⟩,
        ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro name target member
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at member ⊢
        rcases member with member | impossible | member
        · exact Or.inl member
        · have : some target = none := congrArg Prod.snd impossible
          contradiction
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ unchanged),
        rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩

-- Promotion preserves every field target, while changing a unique final
-- reference into shared ownership at the same slot.
theorem Promote.object_data {before after : State} {place : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId}
    (promoted : Promote before place object after) (id : ObjectId) (data : Object)
    (stored : (id, data) ∈ after.objects) :
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      data.className = oldData.className ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name target, (name, some target) ∈ data.fields →
        ∃ oldTarget, (name, some oldTarget) ∈ oldData.fields ∧ target.object = oldTarget.object := by
  cases promoted with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading suffix name object =>
    exact ⟨data, stored, rfl, rfl, fun _ target member => ⟨target, member, rfl⟩⟩
  | field variables nextId leadingObjects trailingObjects parent className
      leadingFields trailingFields fieldName object =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with unchanged | changed | unchanged
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ unchanged, rfl, rfl,
        fun _ target member => ⟨target, member, rfl⟩⟩
    · cases changed
      refine ⟨⟨className, leadingFields ++ (fieldName, some (.owned object)) :: trailingFields⟩,
        ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro name target member
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at member
        rcases member with member | promotedField | member
        · exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_left _ member, rfl⟩
        · cases promotedField
          exact ⟨.owned object, by simp, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member), rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ unchanged),
        rfl, rfl, fun _ target member => ⟨target, member, rfl⟩⟩

end Dada.Shared

    · simp [StructArguments]

theorem example_create_box (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses
      ⟨tokenState, ⟨"b", .new "Box" [.give (.variable "t")]⟩ :: rest⟩ ⟨boxState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.letValue (reference := .owned 1)
    (evaluated := (State.mk tokenState.objects [("t", none)] 1).allocate "Box" ["value"] [.owned 0])
  · simp [State.allocate]
  · apply Eval.new (declaration := ⟨["value"], .structType⟩) (references := [.owned 0])
    · simp [exampleClasses]
    · apply EvalArgs.cons (reference := .owned 0)
      · apply Eval.give
        apply Give.move (source := .variable "t")
        · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .owned 0) (by simp [tokenState])
        · exact Take.variable tokenState.objects 1 [] [] "t" 0
      · exact EvalArgs.nil _
    · rfl
    · decide
    · simp [StructArguments, StructReference, tokenState, exampleClasses, Reference.owned, Kind.isStruct]

theorem example_share_box (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses ⟨boxState, ⟨"s", .giveShare (.variable "b")⟩ :: rest⟩
      ⟨sharedBoxState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.letValue (reference := .shared 1)
    (evaluated := ⟨boxState.objects, [("b", none), ("t", none)], 2⟩)
  · simp
  · apply Eval.giveShare (reference := .owned 1)
    apply Give.move (source := .variable "b")
    · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .owned 1) (by simp [boxState])
    · exact Take.variable boxState.objects 2 [] [("t", none)] "b" 1
    all_goals simp [StructReference, boxState, exampleClasses, Reference.owned, Kind.isStruct]

theorem example_copy_field (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses
      ⟨sharedBoxState, ⟨"u", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩ :: rest⟩
      ⟨copiedState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.letValue (reference := .shared 0)
    (evaluated := ⟨copiedState.objects, sharedBoxState.variables, 2⟩)
  · simp [sharedBoxState]
  · apply Eval.give
    apply Give.promote (source := .field 1 "value")
    · apply Resolve.field (permission := .shared) (reference := .owned 0) (data := ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.owned 0))]⟩)
      · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .shared 1) (by simp [sharedBoxState])
      · simp [sharedBoxState, boxState]
      · simp
    · exact Promote.field sharedBoxState.variables 2 [] [(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)]
        1 "Box" [] [] "value" 0

theorem example_copy_again (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses
      ⟨copiedState, ⟨"v", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩ :: rest⟩

  apply Step.letValue
  · simp [copiedState]
  · apply Eval.give
    apply Give.copy (source := .field 1 "value")
    · apply Resolve.field (permission := .shared) (reference := .shared 0) (data := ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.shared 0))]⟩)
      · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .shared 1) (by simp [copiedState])
      · simp [copiedState]
      · simp
    · exact ⟨⟨"Box", [("value", some (.shared 0))]⟩, by simp [copiedState], by simp⟩

theorem class_construction : ExprTyped classes [] (.new "Resource" [.new "Token" []])

  · exact .cons (.new (declaration := ⟨[], .structType⟩) (by decide)

theorem class_sharing_rejected :
    ¬ ExprTyped classes [("r", some (.whole "Resource"))] (.giveShare (.variable "r")) ty after := by

      some (.whole "Resource", [("r", none)]) := by decide
  rw [operation] at taken
  have same := (Prod.mk.inj (Option.some.inj taken)).1
  subst source
  exact (by decide : ¬ StructType classes (.whole "Resource")) structTy
