import Shared.Liveness

namespace Dada.Shared

-- Declaration kinds constrain references without putting ownership modes on objects.
def objectNames (state : State) : List (ObjectId × ClassName) :=
  state.objects.map fun entry => (entry.1, entry.2.className)

def HasKind (classes : Classes) (state : State) (object : ObjectId) (kind : Kind) : Prop :=
  ∃ name declaration, (object, name) ∈ objectNames state ∧
    (name, declaration) ∈ classes ∧ declaration.kind = kind

def ReferenceAllowed (classes : Classes) (state : State) (reference : Reference) : Prop :=
  ∃ kind, HasKind classes state reference.object kind ∧
    (reference.mode = .shared → kind.isStruct = true) ∧
    (kind = .sharedStruct → reference.mode = .shared)

structure KindCorrect (classes : Classes) (state : State) (pending : List Reference) : Prop where
  references : ∀ reference ∈ pending ++ Owners state, ReferenceAllowed classes state reference
  fields : ∀ object data declaration, (object, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes → declaration.kind.isStruct = true →
    ∀ name reference, (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields →
      StructReference classes state reference

theorem structReference_iff : StructReference classes state reference ↔
    ∃ kind, HasKind classes state reference.object kind ∧ kind.isStruct = true := by
  simp only [StructReference, HasKind, objectNames, List.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨data, declaration, stored, declared, kind⟩
    exact ⟨declaration.kind, ⟨data.className, declaration,
      ⟨(reference.object, data), stored, rfl⟩, declared, rfl⟩, kind⟩
  · rintro ⟨kind, ⟨name, declaration, ⟨⟨object, data⟩, stored, equal⟩, declared, sameKind⟩, isStruct⟩
    cases equal
    exact ⟨data, declaration, stored, declared, sameKind ▸ isStruct⟩

theorem HasKind.frame (same : objectNames before = objectNames after)
    (has : HasKind classes before object kind) : HasKind classes after object kind := by
  simpa only [HasKind, same] using has

theorem ReferenceAllowed.frame (same : objectNames before = objectNames after)
    (allowed : ReferenceAllowed classes before reference) : ReferenceAllowed classes after reference := by
  obtain ⟨kind, has, shareable, immediate⟩ := allowed
  exact ⟨kind, has.frame same, shareable, immediate⟩

theorem StructReference.frame (same : objectNames before = objectNames after)
    (structRef : StructReference classes before reference) : StructReference classes after reference := by
  obtain ⟨kind, has, isStruct⟩ := structReference_iff.mp structRef
  exact structReference_iff.mpr ⟨kind, has.frame same, isStruct⟩

theorem StructReference.shared_allowed (structRef : StructReference classes state reference) :
    ReferenceAllowed classes state (.shared reference.object) := by
  obtain ⟨kind, has, isStruct⟩ := structReference_iff.mp structRef
  exact ⟨kind, has, fun _ => isStruct, fun _ => rfl⟩

theorem owner_variable (stored : (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables) :
    reference ∈ Owners state := by
  exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨_, stored, rfl⟩)

theorem owner_field (stored : (object, data) ∈ state.objects)
    (field : (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields) : reference ∈ Owners state := by
  exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    ⟨_, stored, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨_, field, rfl⟩⟩)

theorem Take.names_preserved (taken : Take before place object after) :
    objectNames before = objectNames after := by
  cases taken <;> simp [objectNames]

theorem Promote.names_preserved (promoted : Promote before place object after) :
    objectNames before = objectNames after := by
  cases promoted <;> simp [objectNames]

theorem Take.remaining_owners (taken : Take before place object after) :
    ∀ reference ∈ Owners after, reference ∈ Owners before := by
  cases taken <;> simp only [Owners, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons,
    List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.mem_filterMap] <;> grind

theorem Promote.remaining_owners (promoted : Promote before place object after) :
    ∀ reference ∈ Owners after, reference ∈ Owners before ∨ reference = .shared object := by
  cases promoted <;> simp only [Owners, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons,
    List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.mem_filterMap] <;> grind

private theorem lookup_unique {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    {entries : List (K × V)} {key : K} {first second : V} (keys : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    (left : (key, first) ∈ entries) (right : (key, second) ∈ entries) : first = second := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp at left
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases List.nodup_cons.mp keys with ⟨fresh, keys⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp left with equal | leftRest
    · cases equal
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp right with equal | right
      · exact (Prod.mk.inj equal).2.symm
      · exact False.elim (fresh (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, right, rfl⟩))
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp right with equal | right
      · cases equal
        exact False.elim (fresh (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, leftRest, rfl⟩))
      · exact ih keys leftRest right

theorem HasKind.at_object (has : HasKind classes state object kind)
    (keys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup) (stored : (object, data) ∈ state.objects) :
    ∃ declaration, (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧ declaration.kind = kind := by
  obtain ⟨name, declaration, named, declared, kindEq⟩ := has
  obtain ⟨⟨id, old⟩, member, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp named
  dsimp only at equal
  have ids := (Prod.mk.inj equal).1
  have names := (Prod.mk.inj equal).2
  subst id
  have same := lookup_unique keys member stored
  subst old
  exact ⟨declaration, names ▸ declared, kindEq⟩

theorem Resolve.allowed (resolved : Resolve state place storage object mode)
    (correct : KindCorrect classes state pending)
    (keys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup) :
    ReferenceAllowed classes state ⟨mode, object⟩ := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored =>
    exact correct.references _ (List.mem_append_right _ (owner_variable stored))
  | @field base source parent permission data name reference route stored field ih =>
    have child := correct.references _ (List.mem_append_right _ (owner_field stored field))
    cases permission with
    | unique => cases reference with
      | reference mode object => cases mode <;> exact child
    | shared =>
      obtain ⟨kind, has, shareable, _⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨declaration, declared, same⟩ := has.at_object keys stored
      have structChild := correct.fields parent data declaration stored declared
        (same ▸ shareable rfl) name reference field
      exact structChild.shared_allowed

theorem KindCorrect.add_pending (correct : KindCorrect classes state pending)
    (allowed : ReferenceAllowed classes state reference) :
    KindCorrect classes state (reference :: pending) := by
  refine ⟨?_, correct.fields⟩
  intro ref member
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with equal | member
  · exact equal ▸ allowed
  · exact correct.references ref member

theorem KindCorrect.take (correct : KindCorrect classes before pending)
    (taken : Take before place object after) : KindCorrect classes after pending := by
  constructor
  · intro ref member
    apply ReferenceAllowed.frame taken.names_preserved
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with member | member
    · exact correct.references ref (List.mem_append_left _ member)
    · exact correct.references ref (List.mem_append_right _ (taken.remaining_owners ref member))
  · intro id data declaration stored declared isStruct name ref field
    obtain ⟨old, oldStored, same, _, fields⟩ := taken.object_data id data stored
    exact (correct.fields id old declaration oldStored (same ▸ declared) isStruct
      name ref (fields name ref field)).frame taken.names_preserved

theorem KindCorrect.promote (correct : KindCorrect classes before pending)
    (promoted : Promote before place object after)
    (allowed : ReferenceAllowed classes before (.shared object)) :
    KindCorrect classes after pending := by
  constructor
  · intro ref member
    apply ReferenceAllowed.frame promoted.names_preserved
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with member | member
    · exact correct.references ref (List.mem_append_left _ member)
    · rcases promoted.remaining_owners ref member with old | same
      · exact correct.references ref (List.mem_append_right _ old)
      · exact same ▸ allowed
  · intro id data declaration stored declared isStruct name ref field
    obtain ⟨old, oldStored, same, _, fields⟩ := promoted.object_data id data stored
    obtain ⟨oldRef, oldField, sameObject⟩ := fields name ref field
    have target := correct.fields id old declaration oldStored (same ▸ declared)
      isStruct name oldRef oldField
    have transferred : StructReference classes before ref := by
      simpa only [StructReference, sameObject] using target
    exact transferred.frame promoted.names_preserved

theorem Give.preserves_kinds (given : Give before place reference after)
    (correct : KindCorrect classes before pending)
    (keys : (before.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup) :
    KindCorrect classes after (reference :: pending) := by
  cases given with
  | move resolved taken =>
    exact (correct.take taken).add_pending ((resolved.allowed correct keys).frame taken.names_preserved)
  | copy resolved _ => exact correct.add_pending (resolved.allowed correct keys)
  | promote resolved promoted =>
    have allowed := resolved.allowed correct keys
    exact (correct.promote promoted allowed).add_pending (allowed.frame promoted.names_preserved)

theorem HasKind.allocate (has : HasKind classes state object kind) :
    HasKind classes (state.allocate name fields arguments) object kind := by
  obtain ⟨target, declaration, member, declared, same⟩ := has
  exact ⟨target, declaration, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member, declared, same⟩

theorem ReferenceAllowed.allocate (allowed : ReferenceAllowed classes state reference) :
    ReferenceAllowed classes (state.allocate name fields arguments) reference := by
  obtain ⟨kind, has, shareable, immediate⟩ := allowed
  exact ⟨kind, has.allocate, shareable, immediate⟩

theorem StructReference.allocate (structRef : StructReference classes state reference) :
    StructReference classes (state.allocate name fields arguments) reference := by
  obtain ⟨kind, has, isStruct⟩ := structReference_iff.mp structRef
  exact structReference_iff.mpr ⟨kind, has.allocate, isStruct⟩

theorem KindCorrect.allocate {references : List Reference} (correct : KindCorrect classes state (references ++ pending))
    (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes) (declared : (name, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (lengths : references.length = declaration.fields.length)
    (structArgs : StructArguments classes state declaration.kind references) :
    KindCorrect classes (state.allocate name declaration.fields references)
      (⟨declaration.kind.mode, ⟨state.nextId⟩⟩ :: pending) := by
  constructor
  · intro ref member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · subst ref
      refine ⟨declaration.kind, ⟨name, declaration, ?_, declared, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact List.mem_cons_self
      · cases declaration.kind <;> simp [Kind.mode, Kind.isStruct]
      · cases declaration.kind <;> simp [Kind.mode]
    · apply ReferenceAllowed.allocate
      apply correct.references
      rcases List.mem_append.mp member with pendingMember | owner
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ pendingMember)
      · have old := (allocation_owners (className := name) state lengths).mem_iff.mp owner
        rcases List.mem_append.mp old with refMember | oldMember
        · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ refMember)
        · exact List.mem_append_right _ oldMember
  · intro object data actual stored actualDeclared isStruct field ref fieldMember
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp stored with same | old
    · cases same
      have sameDeclaration := lookup_unique classesWf.1 declared actualDeclared
      subst actual
      have refMember : ref ∈ references := by
        obtain ⟨_, member, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp (List.of_mem_zip fieldMember).2
        exact Option.some.inj equal ▸ member
      exact (structArgs isStruct ref refMember).allocate
    · exact (correct.fields object data actual old actualDeclared isStruct field ref fieldMember).allocate

theorem KindCorrect.perm (correct : KindCorrect classes state pending)
    (permutation : pending.Perm other) : KindCorrect classes state other := by
  refine ⟨?_, correct.fields⟩
  intro ref member
  exact correct.references ref ((permutation.append_right _).mem_iff.mpr member)

theorem KindCorrect.share_pending (correct : KindCorrect classes state (reference :: pending))
    (structRef : StructReference classes state reference) :
    KindCorrect classes state (.shared reference.object :: pending) := by
  refine ⟨?_, correct.fields⟩
  intro ref member
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
  · exact same ▸ structRef.shared_allowed
  · exact correct.references ref (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)

theorem Eval.preserves_kinds (evaluation : Eval classes before value after reference)
    (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes) (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (correct : KindCorrect classes before pending) : KindCorrect classes after (reference :: pending) := by
  apply Eval.rec
    (motive_1 := fun before _ after reference _ => ∀ pending,
      WellFormedWith classes before pending → KindCorrect classes before pending →
      KindCorrect classes after (reference :: pending))
    (motive_2 := fun before _ after references _ => ∀ pending,
      WellFormedWith classes before pending → KindCorrect classes before pending →
      KindCorrect classes after (references ++ pending))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ evaluation pending wf correct
  · intro state evaluated path reference given pending wf correct
    exact given.preserves_kinds correct wf.objectKeys
  · intro state evaluated path reference given structRef pending wf correct
    exact (given.preserves_kinds correct wf.objectKeys).share_pending structRef
  · intro state evaluated name declaration arguments references declared args lengths fresh structArgs ih pending wf correct
    exact (ih pending wf correct).allocate classesWf declared lengths structArgs
  · intro state pending wf correct
    exact correct
  · intro before middle after argument arguments reference references first rest ihFirst ihRest pending wf correct
    have middleWf := first.preserves_wellFormedWith classesWf wf
    have result := ihRest _ middleWf (ihFirst _ wf correct)
    exact result.perm (by simpa only [List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := reference) (l₁ := references) (l₂ := pending)))

theorem KindCorrect.bind (correct : KindCorrect classes state [reference]) :
    KindCorrect classes (state.bind name reference) [] := by
  constructor
  · intro ref member
    exact correct.references ref (by simpa [Owners, State.bind] using member)
  · intro object data declaration stored declared isStruct field ref member
    exact correct.fields object data declaration stored declared isStruct field ref member

theorem KindCorrect.empty (classes : Classes) : KindCorrect classes State.empty [] := by
  constructor
  · simp [Owners, State.empty]
  · simp [State.empty]

theorem Step.preserves_kinds (step : Step classes before after)
    (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes) (wf : WellFormed classes before.state)
    (correct : KindCorrect classes before.state []) : KindCorrect classes after.state [] := by
  cases step with
  | letValue _ evaluation => exact (evaluation.preserves_kinds classesWf wf.with_pending correct).bind

theorem Steps.kinds_from_initial (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed program.classes)
    (steps : Steps program.classes (Configuration.initial program) after) :
    KindCorrect program.classes after.state [] := by
  have preserve : ∀ before after, Steps program.classes before after →
      WellFormed program.classes before.state → KindCorrect program.classes before.state [] →
      KindCorrect program.classes after.state [] := by
    intro before after steps
    induction steps with
    | refl => intro _ correct; exact correct
    | step first rest ih =>
      intro wf correct
      exact ih (first.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf) (first.preserves_kinds classesWf wf correct)
  exact preserve _ _ steps (WellFormed.empty _) (KindCorrect.empty _)

def WellFormedState (classes : Classes) (state : State) : Prop :=
  WellFormed classes state ∧ KindCorrect classes state []

theorem Steps.wellFormed_from_initial (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed program.classes)
    (steps : Steps program.classes (Configuration.initial program) after) :
    WellFormedState program.classes after.state :=
  ⟨steps.from_initial classesWf, steps.kinds_from_initial classesWf⟩

theorem WellFormedState.live_iff_allocated (wf : WellFormedState classes state) :
    Live state object ↔ Allocated state object := wf.1.live_iff_allocated

theorem WellFormedState.path_mode_exclusive (wf : WellFormedState classes state)
    (unique : Resolve state uniquePath uniquePlace object .unique)
    (shared : Resolve state sharedPath sharedPlace object .shared) : False :=
  wf.1.path_mode_exclusive unique shared

import Shared.Soundness
import Common.Rooted

namespace Dada.Shared

private def VariableRoot (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  ∃ name reference, (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables ∧ reference.object = object

private def FieldEdge (state : State) (parent object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  ∃ data name reference, (parent, data) ∈ state.objects ∧
    (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields ∧ reference.object = object

private theorem reference_origin {state : State} {object : ObjectId}
    (member : object ∈ References state) :
    VariableRoot state object ∨ ∃ parent, Allocated state parent ∧ FieldEdge state parent object := by
  simp only [References, List.mem_append, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_flatMap] at member
  rcases member with root | field
  · obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, stored, value⟩ := root
    obtain ⟨reference, sameSlot, sameTarget⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp value
    dsimp at sameSlot
    subst slot
    exact Or.inl ⟨name, reference, stored, sameTarget⟩
  · obtain ⟨⟨parent, data⟩, allocated, ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, stored, value⟩⟩ := field
    obtain ⟨reference, sameSlot, sameTarget⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp value
    dsimp at sameSlot
    subst slot
    exact Or.inr ⟨parent, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(parent, data), allocated, rfl⟩,
      data, name, reference, allocated, stored, sameTarget⟩

-- Sharing can introduce several incoming owning edges, but every finite
-- backwards path through fields must still reach a variable root.
theorem WellFormed.allocated_live (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (allocated : Allocated state object) : Live state object := by
  have rooted : Dada.Common.Rooted (VariableRoot state) (FieldEdge state) object :=
    Dada.Common.rooted_of_covered ObjectId.index state.nextId
      (fun node member => by
        obtain ⟨⟨_, data⟩, stored, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
        exact wf.bounds _ data stored)
      (fun node member => reference_origin ((wf.referencesComplete node).mpr member))
      (fun parent node _ edge => by
        obtain ⟨data, name, reference, stored, field, sameTarget⟩ := edge
        simpa [sameTarget] using wf.older parent data name reference stored field)
      object allocated
  clear allocated
  induction rooted with
  | root atRoot =>
    obtain ⟨name, reference, stored, sameTarget⟩ := atRoot
    simpa [sameTarget] using Live.variable stored
  | field _ edge ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, name, reference, stored, field, sameTarget⟩ := edge
    simpa [sameTarget] using Live.field ih stored field

theorem WellFormed.live_allocated (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (live : Live state object) : Allocated state object := by
  apply (wf.referencesComplete object).mp
  cases live with
  | «variable» stored =>
    exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field _ stored field =>
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr
      ⟨(_, _), stored, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, _), field, rfl⟩⟩)

theorem WellFormed.live_iff_allocated (wf : WellFormed classes state) :
    Live state object ↔ Allocated state object :=
  ⟨wf.live_allocated, wf.allocated_live⟩

theorem WellFormed.owner_count_positive (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (allocated : Allocated state object) : 0 < (References state).count object :=
  List.count_pos_iff.mpr ((wf.referencesComplete object).mpr allocated)

-- A unique owner excludes every other owning occurrence, including shared ones.
-- Shared owners are counted separately even when their reference values coincide.
theorem WellFormed.unique_owner_count (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (unique : Reference.owned object ∈ Owners state) :
    (References state).count object = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨leading, trailing, decomposition⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp unique
  have reordered : (Owners state).Perm (Reference.owned object :: (leading ++ trailing)) := by
    rw [decomposition]
    exact List.perm_middle
  have compatible := reordered.pairwise wf.ownersCompatible (by
    intro first second relation
    rcases relation with different | shared
    · exact Or.inl (Ne.symm different)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨shared.2, shared.1⟩)
  have absent : object ∉ (leading ++ trailing).map Reference.object := by
    intro member
    obtain ⟨reference, found, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    have relation := (List.pairwise_cons.mp compatible).1 reference found
    rcases relation with different | shared
    · exact different same.symm
    · cases shared.1
  have targets : (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
    simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]
  have counted := (reordered.map Reference.object).count_eq object
  rw [targets] at counted
  rw [counted]
  change (object :: (leading ++ trailing).map Reference.object).count object = 1
  rw [List.count_cons, List.count_eq_zero.mpr absent]
  simp


private def LocatedOwners (state : State) : List (StoragePlace × Reference) :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2.map (fun r => (.variable binding.1, r))) ++
    state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap
      (fun field => field.2.map (fun r => (.field entry.1 field.1, r))))

private theorem located_owners (state : State) :
    (LocatedOwners state).map Prod.snd = Owners state := by
  simp [LocatedOwners, Owners, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap, Function.comp_def]

private theorem stored_located (stored : Stored state place (some reference)) :
    (place, reference) ∈ LocatedOwners state := by
  cases place with
  | «variable» name =>
    exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field object name =>
    obtain ⟨data, member, field⟩ := stored
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(object, data), member,
      List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), field, rfl⟩⟩)

private theorem located_eq_or_compatible {owners : List (StoragePlace × Reference)}
    (pairwise : owners.Pairwise (fun a b => Compatible a.2 b.2))
    (first : a ∈ owners) (second : b ∈ owners) : a = b ∨ Compatible a.2 b.2 := by
  induction owners with
  | nil => simp at first
  | cons head tail ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp first with firstEq | firstTail
    · subst a
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp second with secondEq | secondTail
      · exact Or.inl secondEq.symm
      · exact Or.inr ((List.pairwise_cons.mp pairwise).1 _ secondTail)
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp second with secondEq | secondTail
      · subst b
        apply Or.inr
        rcases (List.pairwise_cons.mp pairwise).1 _ firstTail with different | shared
        · exact Or.inl different.symm
        · exact Or.inr ⟨shared.2, shared.1⟩
      · exact ih pairwise.of_cons firstTail secondTail

private theorem WellFormed.unique_storage (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (owned : Stored state place (some (.owned object)))
    (stored : Stored state otherPlace (some reference))
    (target : reference.object = object) :
    otherPlace = place ∧ reference = .owned object := by
  have pairwise : (LocatedOwners state).Pairwise (fun a b => Compatible a.2 b.2) := by
    apply List.pairwise_map.mp
    simpa [located_owners] using wf.ownersCompatible
  rcases located_eq_or_compatible pairwise (stored_located owned) (stored_located stored) with
    same | compatible
  · exact ⟨(congrArg Prod.fst same).symm, (congrArg Prod.snd same).symm⟩
  · rcases compatible with different | shared
    · exact False.elim (different target.symm)
    · cases shared.1

private theorem reference_eq_owned {reference : Reference} (unique : reference.mode = .unique) :
    reference = .owned reference.object := by
  cases reference with
  | reference mode object => cases unique; rfl

private theorem Mode.join_unique {first second : Mode} (unique : first.join second = .unique) :
    first = .unique ∧ second = .unique := by
  cases first <;> cases second <;> simp_all [Mode.join]

private theorem Resolve.unique_mode (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (resolved : Resolve state path place object permission)
    (unique : permission = .unique)
    (other : Resolve state otherPath otherPlace otherObject mode)
    (sameTarget : otherObject = object) : mode = .unique := by
  induction resolved generalizing otherPath otherPlace otherObject mode with
  | @«variable» name reference stored =>
    have owned : Stored state (.variable name) (some (.owned reference.object)) := by
      change (name, some (.owned reference.object)) ∈ state.variables
      rw [← reference_eq_owned unique]
      exact stored
    cases other with
    | @«variable» otherName otherReference otherStored =>
      have same := wf.unique_storage owned (otherPlace := .variable otherName) otherStored sameTarget
      exact congrArg Reference.mode same.2
    | @field otherBase otherSource otherParent otherPermission otherData otherName otherReference base parentStored fieldStored =>
      have same := wf.unique_storage owned
        (otherPlace := .field otherParent otherName) ⟨otherData, parentStored, fieldStored⟩ sameTarget
      cases same.1
  | @field base source parent permission data name reference baseResolved parentStored fieldStored ih =>
    have modes := Mode.join_unique unique
    have owned : Stored state (.field parent name) (some (.owned reference.object)) := by
      refine ⟨data, parentStored, ?_⟩
      rw [← reference_eq_owned modes.2]
      exact fieldStored
    cases other with
    | @«variable» otherName otherReference otherStored =>
      have same := wf.unique_storage owned
        (otherPlace := .variable otherName) otherStored sameTarget
      cases same.1
    | @field otherBase otherSource otherParent otherPermission otherData otherName otherReference
        otherResolved otherParentStored otherFieldStored =>
      have same := wf.unique_storage owned
        (otherPlace := .field otherParent otherName)
        ⟨otherData, otherParentStored, otherFieldStored⟩ sameTarget
      have parentEqual : otherParent = parent := (StoragePlace.field.inj same.1).1
      have prefixMode := ih modes.1 otherResolved parentEqual
      have fieldMode := congrArg Reference.mode same.2
      rw [prefixMode, fieldMode]
      rfl

-- References along two variable-rooted paths to one object cannot disagree
-- between all-unique access and access that crosses a shared reference.
theorem WellFormed.path_mode_exclusive (wf : WellFormed classes state)
    (unique : Resolve state uniquePath uniquePlace object .unique)
    (shared : Resolve state sharedPath sharedPlace object .shared) : False := by
  have impossible := unique.unique_mode wf rfl shared rfl
  cases impossible

end Dada.Shared

import Shared.Effects

namespace Dada.Shared

def ClassesWellFormed (classes : Classes) : Prop :=
  (classes.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    ∀ name declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ classes → declaration.fields.Nodup

-- Each list entry represents one owning occurrence, including repeated shared
-- references stored in different slots.
def Owners (state : State) : List Reference :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
    state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))

-- Different occurrences may target the same object only when both are shared.
def Compatible (first second : Reference) : Prop :=
  first.object ≠ second.object ∨ first.mode = .shared ∧ second.mode = .shared

structure WellFormed (classes : Classes) (state : State) : Prop where
  objectKeys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  variableKeys : (state.variables.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  shapes : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    ∃ declaration, (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields ∧ declaration.fields.Nodup
  bounds : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects → id.index < state.nextId
  older : ∀ id data name reference, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields → reference.object.index < id.index
  ownersCompatible : (Owners state).Pairwise Compatible
  referencesComplete : ∀ id, id ∈ References state ↔ Allocated state id

private abbrev slotOwners {K : Type} (slots : List (K × Slot)) : List Reference :=
  slots.filterMap (fun entry => entry.2)

private theorem owners_targets (state : State) : (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
  simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]

private theorem compatible_symm {first second : Reference} (h : Compatible first second) :
    Compatible second first := by
  rcases h with different | shared
  · exact Or.inl (Ne.symm different)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨shared.2, shared.1⟩

private theorem compatible_weaken {first second : Reference} (h : Compatible first second) :
    Compatible (.shared first.object) second := by
  rcases h with different | shared
  · exact Or.inl different
  · exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, shared.2⟩

private theorem pairwise_weaken (h : (reference :: others).Pairwise Compatible) :
    (Reference.shared reference.object :: others).Pairwise Compatible := by
  exact List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨fun _ member => compatible_weaken
    ((List.pairwise_cons.mp h).1 _ member), h.of_cons⟩

private theorem shared_compatible_all {owners : List Reference} (h : owners.Pairwise Compatible)
    (member : Reference.shared object ∈ owners) :
    ∀ reference ∈ owners, Compatible (.shared object) reference := by
  induction owners with
  | nil => simp at member
  | cons head tail ih =>
    have parts := List.pairwise_cons.mp h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | inside
    · subst head
      intro reference found
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp found with same | rest
      · subst reference
        exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact parts.1 _ rest
    · intro reference found
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp found with same | rest
      · subst reference
        exact compatible_symm (parts.1 _ inside)
      · exact ih parts.2 inside _ rest

private theorem pairwise_copy {owners : List Reference} (h : owners.Pairwise Compatible)
    (member : Reference.shared object ∈ owners) :
    (Reference.shared object :: owners).Pairwise Compatible :=
  List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨shared_compatible_all h member, h⟩

theorem Take.object_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.variable_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.next_id (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.nextId = before.nextId := by
  cases take <;> rfl

theorem Promote.object_keys (promote : Promote before place object after) :
    after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  cases promote <;> simp

theorem Promote.variable_keys (promote : Promote before place object after) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases promote <;> simp

theorem Promote.next_id (promote : Promote before place object after) :
    after.nextId = before.nextId := by
  cases promote <;> rfl

theorem Take.owners (take : Take before place object after) :
    (Owners before).Perm (Reference.owned object :: Owners after) := by
  cases take with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [Owners, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := Reference.owned object)
        (l₁ := slotOwners leading)
        (l₂ := slotOwners suffix ++ objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields)))
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [Owners, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.filterMap_append,
      List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := Reference.owned object)
        (l₁ := slotOwners variables ++ before.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields) ++
          slotOwners leading)
        (l₂ := slotOwners suffix ++ after.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields)))

theorem Promote.owners (promote : Promote before place object after) :
    ∃ rest, (Owners before).Perm (Reference.owned object :: rest) ∧
      (Owners after).Perm (Reference.shared object :: rest) := by
  cases promote with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    refine ⟨slotOwners leading ++ slotOwners suffix ++
      objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields), ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp [Owners, List.append_assoc, slotOwners]
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    refine ⟨slotOwners variables ++ before.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields) ++
      slotOwners leading ++ slotOwners suffix ++ after.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields),
      ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simpa [Owners, List.append_assoc, slotOwners] using
        (List.perm_middle
          (l₁ := slotOwners variables ++ before.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields) ++
            slotOwners leading)
          (l₂ := slotOwners suffix ++ after.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields)))

private theorem stored_owner (stored : Stored state place (some reference)) :
    reference ∈ Owners state := by
  cases place with
  | «variable» name =>
    exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field object name =>
    obtain ⟨data, member, field⟩ := stored
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(object, data), member,
      List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), field, rfl⟩⟩)

theorem WellFormed.empty (classes : Classes) : WellFormed classes State.empty := by
  constructor <;> simp [State.empty, Owners, References, Allocated]


-- The storage frame records the unchanged identities and layouts. Initialized
-- fields may disappear or weaken to shared ownership, but keep their targets.
private structure StorageFrame (before after : State) : Prop where
  objectKeys : after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst
  variableKeys : after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst
  nextId : after.nextId = before.nextId
  data : ∀ id newData, (id, newData) ∈ after.objects →
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      newData.className = oldData.className ∧
      newData.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name reference, (name, some reference) ∈ newData.fields →
        ∃ oldReference, (name, some oldReference) ∈ oldData.fields ∧
          reference.object = oldReference.object

private theorem Take.frame (take : Take before place object after) : StorageFrame before after := by
  refine ⟨take.object_keys, take.variable_keys, take.next_id, ?_⟩
  intro id data member
  obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, remaining⟩ := take.object_data id data member
  exact ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, fun name reference found =>
    ⟨reference, remaining name reference found, rfl⟩⟩

private theorem Promote.frame (promote : Promote before place object after) : StorageFrame before after :=
  ⟨promote.object_keys, promote.variable_keys, promote.next_id, promote.object_data⟩

private theorem StorageFrame.refl (state : State) : StorageFrame state state := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro id data member
  exact ⟨data, member, rfl, rfl, fun _ reference field => ⟨reference, field, rfl⟩⟩

private theorem Give.frame (give : Give before path reference after) : StorageFrame before after := by
  cases give with
  | move _ take => exact take.frame
  | copy => exact StorageFrame.refl _
  | promote _ promotion => exact promotion.frame

private theorem Give.owners_compatible (give : Give before path reference after)
    (compatible : (Owners before).Pairwise Compatible) :
    (reference :: Owners after).Pairwise Compatible := by
  cases give with
  | move _ take => exact take.owners.pairwise compatible compatible_symm
  | copy _ stored => exact pairwise_copy compatible (stored_owner stored)
  | promote _ promotion =>
    obtain ⟨rest, oldPerm, newPerm⟩ := promotion.owners
    have promoted := pairwise_weaken (oldPerm.pairwise compatible compatible_symm)
    have duplicate := pairwise_copy promoted (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    exact (List.Perm.cons _ newPerm).symm.pairwise duplicate compatible_symm

private theorem Promote.references (promotion : Promote before place object after) :
    References after = References before := by
  cases promotion <;> simp [References, Reference.owned, Reference.shared]

private theorem Give.targets (give : Give before path reference after) (object : ObjectId) :
    object ∈ (reference :: Owners after).map Reference.object ↔ object ∈ References before := by
  cases give with
  | move _ take =>
    simpa [owners_targets] using (take.owners.map Reference.object).mem_iff.symm
  | copy _ stored =>
    have member := List.mem_map_of_mem (f := Reference.object) (stored_owner stored)
    rw [owners_targets] at member
    simp only [List.map_cons, owners_targets, List.mem_cons]
    exact or_iff_right_of_imp (fun same => same ▸ member)
  | promote _ promotion =>
    obtain ⟨rest, oldPerm, _⟩ := promotion.owners
    have present := (oldPerm.map Reference.object).mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    rw [owners_targets] at present
    simp only [List.map_cons, owners_targets, promotion.references, List.mem_cons]
    exact or_iff_right_of_imp (fun same => same ▸ present)

theorem Give.bind_preserves (wf : WellFormed classes before)
    (give : Give before path reference after)
    (fresh : destination ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    WellFormed classes (after.bind destination reference) := by
  have frame := give.frame
  constructor
  · simpa [State.bind, frame.objectKeys] using wf.objectKeys
  · simpa [State.bind, frame.variableKeys] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fresh, wf.variableKeys⟩
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, _⟩ := frame.data id data member
    obtain ⟨declaration, declared, fields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes id oldData oldMember
    exact ⟨declaration, sameClass ▸ declared, sameFields.trans fields, distinct⟩
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, _⟩ := frame.data id data member
    simpa [State.bind, frame.nextId] using wf.bounds id oldData oldMember
  · intro id data name target member field
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, remaining⟩ := frame.data id data member
    obtain ⟨oldTarget, oldField, sameTarget⟩ := remaining name target field
    rw [sameTarget]
    exact wf.older id oldData name oldTarget oldMember oldField
  · simpa [State.bind, Owners] using give.owners_compatible wf.ownersCompatible
  · intro id
    have target := give.targets id
    rw [← owners_targets (after.bind destination reference)]
    simpa [Allocated, State.bind, Owners, frame.objectKeys] using
      target.trans (wf.referencesComplete id)

theorem WellFormed.share_result {state : State} {name : VariableId} {reference : Reference}
    (wf : WellFormed classes (state.bind name reference)) :
    WellFormed classes (state.bind name (.shared reference.object)) := by
  constructor
  · exact wf.objectKeys
  · exact wf.variableKeys
  · exact wf.shapes
  · exact wf.bounds
  · exact wf.older
  · have compatible : (reference :: Owners state).Pairwise Compatible := by
      simpa [Owners, State.bind] using wf.ownersCompatible
    simpa [Owners, State.bind] using pairwise_weaken compatible
  · simpa [References, State.bind, Reference.shared, Allocated] using wf.referencesComplete


-- Expression evaluation temporarily holds owners outside the variable and field
-- stores. Pending owners are included until a constructor or let stores them.
structure WellFormedWith (classes : Classes) (state : State) (pending : List Reference) : Prop where
  objectKeys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  variableKeys : (state.variables.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  shapes : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    ∃ declaration, (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields ∧ declaration.fields.Nodup
  bounds : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects → id.index < state.nextId
  older : ∀ id data name reference, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields → reference.object.index < id.index
  ownersCompatible : (pending ++ Owners state).Pairwise Compatible
  referencesComplete : ∀ id, id ∈ (pending.map Reference.object ++ References state) ↔ Allocated state id

theorem WellFormed.with_pending (wf : WellFormed classes state) :
    WellFormedWith classes state [] := by
  exact ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, wf.older,
    by simpa using wf.ownersCompatible, by simpa using wf.referencesComplete⟩

theorem WellFormedWith.no_pending (wf : WellFormedWith classes state []) :
    WellFormed classes state := by
  exact ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, wf.older,
    by simpa using wf.ownersCompatible, by simpa using wf.referencesComplete⟩

theorem WellFormedWith.perm (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (permutation : pending.Perm other) : WellFormedWith classes state other := by
  refine ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, wf.older, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (permutation.append_right _).pairwise wf.ownersCompatible compatible_symm
  · intro id
    exact ((permutation.map Reference.object).append_right _).mem_iff.symm.trans
      (wf.referencesComplete id)

private theorem Give.pending_compatible (give : Give before path reference after)
    (compatible : (pending ++ Owners before).Pairwise Compatible) :
    (reference :: pending ++ Owners after).Pairwise Compatible := by
  cases give with
  | move _ take =>
    have moved := (take.owners.append_left pending).pairwise compatible compatible_symm
    exact (by simpa only [List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := Reference.owned _) (l₁ := pending)
        (l₂ := Owners after)).pairwise moved compatible_symm)
  | copy _ stored =>
    exact pairwise_copy compatible (List.mem_append_right _ (stored_owner stored))
  | promote _ promotion =>
    obtain ⟨rest, oldPerm, newPerm⟩ := promotion.owners
    have front := (List.perm_middle (a := Reference.owned _) (l₁ := pending) (l₂ := rest)).pairwise
      ((oldPerm.append_left pending).pairwise compatible compatible_symm) compatible_symm
    have promoted := pairwise_weaken front
    have copied := pairwise_copy promoted (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have rearranged := (List.Perm.cons _
      (List.perm_middle (a := Reference.shared _) (l₁ := pending) (l₂ := rest)).symm).pairwise
        copied compatible_symm
    exact (List.Perm.cons _ (newPerm.symm.append_left pending)).pairwise rearranged compatible_symm

theorem Give.preserves_pending (give : Give before path reference after)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending) :
    WellFormedWith classes after (reference :: pending) := by
  have frame := give.frame
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, give.pending_compatible wf.ownersCompatible, ?_⟩
  · simpa [frame.objectKeys] using wf.objectKeys
  · simpa [frame.variableKeys] using wf.variableKeys
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, _⟩ := frame.data id data member
    obtain ⟨declaration, declared, fields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes id oldData oldMember
    exact ⟨declaration, sameClass ▸ declared, sameFields.trans fields, distinct⟩
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, _⟩ := frame.data id data member
    simpa [frame.nextId] using wf.bounds id oldData oldMember
  · intro id data name target member field
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, remaining⟩ := frame.data id data member
    obtain ⟨oldTarget, oldField, sameTarget⟩ := remaining name target field
    rw [sameTarget]
    exact wf.older id oldData name oldTarget oldMember oldField
  · intro id
    have targets := give.targets id
    simp only [List.map_cons, owners_targets, List.mem_cons] at targets
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons_append, List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
    rw [or_left_comm, targets]
    simpa [List.mem_append, Allocated, frame.objectKeys] using wf.referencesComplete id

theorem WellFormedWith.share_result
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes state (reference :: pending)) :
    WellFormedWith classes state (.shared reference.object :: pending) := by
  refine ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, wf.older,
    pairwise_weaken wf.ownersCompatible, ?_⟩
  simpa [Reference.shared] using wf.referencesComplete

private theorem zipped_field_names (fields : List FieldName) (references : List Reference)
    (lengths : references.length = fields.length) :
    (fields.zip (references.map some)).map Prod.fst = fields := by
  apply List.map_fst_zip
  simp [lengths]

private theorem zipped_field_owners (fields : List FieldName) (references : List Reference)
    (lengths : references.length = fields.length) :
    slotOwners (fields.zip (references.map some)) = references := by
  have seconds := List.map_snd_zip (l₁ := fields) (l₂ := references.map some)
    (by simp [lengths])
  have filtered := congrArg (List.filterMap id) seconds
  simpa [List.filterMap_map, Function.comp_def, slotOwners] using filtered

theorem allocation_owners (state : State)
    (lengths : references.length = fields.length) :
    (Owners (state.allocate className fields references)).Perm (references ++ Owners state) := by
  simp only [Owners, State.allocate, List.flatMap_cons]
  rw [show List.filterMap (fun field => field.2) (fields.zip (references.map some)) = references
    from zipped_field_owners fields references lengths]
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
    (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := slotOwners state.variables) (l₂ := references)).append_right
      (state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotOwners entry.2.fields))

theorem WellFormedWith.pending_bound (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (member : reference ∈ pending) : reference.object.index < state.nextId := by
  have referred := List.mem_append_left (References state)
    (List.mem_map_of_mem (f := Reference.object) member)
  obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, allocated, equality⟩ :=
    List.mem_map.mp ((wf.referencesComplete reference.object).mp referred)
  simp only at equality
  subst id
  exact wf.bounds reference.object data allocated

theorem WellFormedWith.allocate (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes state (references ++ pending))
    (declared : (className, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (lengths : references.length = declaration.fields.length)
    (freshObject : ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ state.objects.map Prod.fst) :
    WellFormedWith classes (state.allocate className declaration.fields references)
      (Reference.owned ⟨state.nextId⟩ :: pending) := by
  have perm := allocation_owners (className := className) state lengths
  have combined : (pending ++ Owners (state.allocate className declaration.fields references)).Perm
      (references ++ pending ++ Owners state) :=
    (perm.append_left pending).trans (by
      simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
        (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := pending) (l₂ := references)).append_right (Owners state))
  refine ⟨?_, wf.variableKeys, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [State.allocate] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨freshObject, wf.objectKeys⟩
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact ⟨declaration, declared, zipped_field_names _ _ lengths, classesWf.2 _ _ declared⟩
    · exact wf.shapes id data old
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (wf.bounds id data old)
  · intro id data name target member field
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      have referred : target ∈ slotOwners (declaration.fields.zip (references.map some)) :=
        List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some target), field, rfl⟩
      rw [zipped_field_owners _ _ lengths] at referred
      exact wf.pending_bound (List.mem_append_left _ referred)
    · exact wf.older id data name target old field
  · apply List.pairwise_cons.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, combined.symm.pairwise wf.ownersCompatible compatible_symm⟩
    intro reference member
    apply Or.inl
    intro same
    have referred := List.mem_map_of_mem (f := Reference.object) (combined.mem_iff.mp member)
    simp only [List.map_append, owners_targets] at referred
    have allocated := (wf.referencesComplete reference.object).mp (by simpa only [List.map_append] using referred)
    change ObjectId.mk state.nextId = reference.object at same
    exact freshObject (by simpa only [Allocated, same] using allocated)
  · intro id
    have targets := (combined.map Reference.object).mem_iff (a := id)
    simp only [List.map_append, owners_targets] at targets
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons_append, List.mem_cons]
    rw [targets, ← List.map_append, wf.referencesComplete]
    simp [Allocated, State.allocate, Reference.owned]

theorem WellFormedWith.bind (wf : WellFormedWith classes state [reference])
    (fresh : destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    WellFormed classes (state.bind destination reference) := by
  refine ⟨wf.objectKeys, ?_, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, wf.older, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [State.bind] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fresh, wf.variableKeys⟩
  · simpa [State.bind, Owners] using wf.ownersCompatible
  · simpa [State.bind, References, Allocated] using wf.referencesComplete

theorem Eval.preserves_wellFormedWith (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (evaluation : Eval classes before expression after reference)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending) :
    WellFormedWith classes after (reference :: pending) := by
  apply Eval.rec
    (motive_1 := fun before _ after reference _ => ∀ pending,
      WellFormedWith classes before pending → WellFormedWith classes after (reference :: pending))
    (motive_2 := fun before _ after references _ => ∀ pending,
      WellFormedWith classes before pending → WellFormedWith classes after (references ++ pending))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ evaluation pending wf
  · intro state evaluated path reference give pending wf
    exact give.preserves_pending wf
  · intro state evaluated path reference give _ pending wf
    exact (give.preserves_pending wf).share_result
  · intro state evaluated className declaration arguments references declared args lengths fresh _ ih pending wf
    have allocated := (ih pending wf).allocate classesWf declared lengths fresh
    cases declaration.kind with
    | classType => exact allocated
    | structType => exact allocated
    | sharedStruct => exact allocated.share_result
  · intro state pending wf
    exact wf
  · intro before middle after argument arguments reference references first rest ihFirst ihRest pending wf
    have result := ihRest (reference :: pending) (ihFirst pending wf)
    exact result.perm (by
      simpa only [List.cons_append] using
        List.perm_middle (a := reference) (l₁ := references) (l₂ := pending))

theorem Eval.variable_keys (evaluation : Eval classes before value after reference) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  induction evaluation using Eval.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ after _ _ =>
      after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst) with
  | give give => exact give.frame.variableKeys
  | giveShare give _ => exact give.frame.variableKeys
  | new _ _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact rest.trans first

theorem EvalArgs.length (evaluation : EvalArgs classes before arguments after references) :
    references.length = arguments.length := by
  induction evaluation using EvalArgs.rec
    (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | giveShare => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ rest => simpa using rest

theorem Step.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  cases step with
  | letValue fresh evaluation =>
    exact (evaluation.preserves_wellFormedWith classesWf wf.with_pending).bind fresh

theorem Steps.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (steps : Steps classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact wf
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (first.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf)

theorem Steps.from_initial (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed program.classes)
    (steps : Steps program.classes (Configuration.initial program) after) :
    WellFormed program.classes after.state :=
  steps.preserves_wellFormed classesWf (WellFormed.empty _)

end Dada.Shared

namespace Dada.Shared

inductive Mode where
  | unique
  | shared
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- Shared access is retained through every remaining projection.
def Mode.join : Mode → Mode → Mode
  | .unique, .unique => .unique
  | _, _ => .shared

def Kind.mode : Kind → Mode
  | .sharedStruct => .shared
  | _ => .unique

structure Reference where
  reference ::
  mode : Mode
  object : ObjectId
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Reference.owned (object : ObjectId) : Reference := ⟨.unique, object⟩

def Reference.shared (object : ObjectId) : Reference := ⟨.shared, object⟩

-- An empty slot is still allocated, but contributes no owner.
abbrev Slot := Option Reference

structure Object where
  className : ClassName
  fields : List (FieldName × Slot)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure State where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  variables : List (VariableId × Slot)
  nextId : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def State.empty : State := ⟨[], [], 0⟩

inductive StoragePlace where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | field (object : ObjectId) (name : FieldName)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Stored (state : State) (place : StoragePlace) (slot : Slot) : Prop :=
  match place with
  | .variable name => (name, slot) ∈ state.variables
  | .field object name =>
      ∃ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ (name, slot) ∈ data.fields

def References (state : State) : List ObjectId :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2.map Reference.object) ++
    state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap
      (fun field => field.2.map Reference.object))

def Allocated (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  object ∈ state.objects.map Prod.fst

-- Liveness follows owners from a variable, then through initialized fields.
inductive Live (state : State) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable {name reference} :
      (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables → Live state reference.object
  | field {parent reference data name} :
      Live state parent → (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields → Live state reference.object

structure Configuration where
  state : State
  code : List Statement
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.initial (program : Program) : Configuration :=
  ⟨State.empty, program.body⟩

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.code = []

end Dada.Shared

import Shared.State

namespace Dada.Shared

-- Resolve records the effective permission of the whole path. A shared link
-- makes all subsequent access shared, even when a later stored link is unique.
inductive Resolve (state : State) : Place → StoragePlace → ObjectId → Mode → Prop where
  | variable {name reference} :
      (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables →
      Resolve state (.variable name) (.variable name) reference.object reference.mode
  | field {base source parent permission data name reference} :
      Resolve state base source parent permission →
      (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields →
      Resolve state (.field base name) (.field parent name) reference.object
        (permission.join reference.mode)

-- Only a unique reference can be taken; copying leaves the source initialized.
inductive Take : State → StoragePlace → ObjectId → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) object
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : Nat)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) object
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

-- A copy of a unique final field through shared access first promotes precisely
-- that stored owner to shared. This changes permissions, not object identity,
-- field names, or the represented field value.
inductive Promote : State → StoragePlace → ObjectId → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) :
      Promote ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) object
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : Nat)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (object : ObjectId) :
      Promote ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some (.owned object)) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) object
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some (.shared object)) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

inductive Give : State → Place → Reference → State → Prop where
  | move {state cleared : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object .unique →
      Take state source object cleared →
      Give state path (.owned object) cleared
  | copy {state : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object .shared →
      Stored state source (some (.shared object)) →
      Give state path (.shared object) state
  | promote {state promoted : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object .shared →
      Promote state source object promoted →
      Give state path (.shared object) promoted

def State.bind (state : State) (name : VariableId) (reference : Reference) : State :=
  { state with variables := (name, some reference) :: state.variables }

def State.allocate (state : State) (className : ClassName) (fields : List FieldName)
    (references : List Reference) : State :=
  ⟨(⟨state.nextId⟩, ⟨className, fields.zip (references.map some)⟩) :: state.objects,
    state.variables, state.nextId + 1⟩

def StructReference (classes : Classes) (state : State) (reference : Reference) : Prop :=
  ∃ data declaration, (reference.object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧
    (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧ declaration.kind.isStruct = true

def StructArguments (classes : Classes) (state : State) (kind : Kind)
    (references : List Reference) : Prop :=
  kind.isStruct = true → ∀ reference ∈ references, StructReference classes state reference

mutual
inductive Eval (classes : Classes) : State → Value → State → Reference → Prop where
  | give {state evaluated : State} {path : Place} {reference : Reference} :
      Give state path reference evaluated →
      Eval classes state (.give path) evaluated reference
  | giveShare {state evaluated : State} {path : Place} {reference : Reference} :
      Give state path reference evaluated →
      StructReference classes evaluated reference →
      Eval classes state (.giveShare path) evaluated (.shared reference.object)
  | new {state evaluated : State} {className : ClassName} {declaration : Class}
      {arguments : List Value} {references : List Reference} :
      (className, declaration) ∈ classes →
      EvalArgs classes state arguments evaluated references →
      references.length = declaration.fields.length →
      ObjectId.mk evaluated.nextId ∉ evaluated.objects.map Prod.fst →
      StructArguments classes evaluated declaration.kind references →
      Eval classes state (.new className arguments)
        (evaluated.allocate className declaration.fields references) (⟨declaration.kind.mode, ⟨evaluated.nextId⟩⟩)

inductive EvalArgs (classes : Classes) : State → List Value → State → List Reference → Prop where
  | nil (state : State) : EvalArgs classes state [] state []
  | cons {before middle after : State} {argument : Value} {arguments : List Value}
      {reference : Reference} {references : List Reference} :
      Eval classes before argument middle reference →
      EvalArgs classes middle arguments after references →
      EvalArgs classes before (argument :: arguments) after (reference :: references)
end

inductive Step (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | letValue {state evaluated : State} {destination : VariableId} {value : Value}
      {reference : Reference} {rest : List Statement} :
      destination ∉ evaluated.variables.map Prod.fst →
      Eval classes state value evaluated reference →
      Step classes ⟨state, ⟨destination, value⟩ :: rest⟩
        ⟨evaluated.bind destination reference, rest⟩

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes before middle → Steps classes middle after → Steps classes before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes configuration after

end Dada.Shared

inductive Kind where

def Kind.isStruct : Kind → Bool

structure Class where

abbrev Classes := List (ClassName × Class)

-- Places name storage; evaluating a place alone does not produce a value.
inductive Place where

  | field (base : Place) (name : FieldName)

def ConfigurationTyped (classes : ClassTable) (configuration : Unpacking.Configuration)
    (finalEnvironment : Environment) : Prop :=
  ∃ current, Realizes classes current configuration.state [] ∧
    SequenceTyped classes current configuration.code finalEnvironment

theorem ConfigurationTyped.initial
    (typed : ProgramTyped classes code) :
    ∃ finalEnvironment, ConfigurationTyped classes ⟨State.empty, code⟩ finalEnvironment := by
  obtain ⟨classesWf, finalEnvironment, sequence⟩ := typed
  exact ⟨finalEnvironment, [], Realizes.empty classesWf, sequence⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finished
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment)
    (finished : configuration.finished) :
    Realizes classes finalEnvironment configuration.state [] := by
  obtain ⟨current, realized, sequence⟩ := typed
  change configuration.code = [] at finished
  rw [finished] at sequence
  cases sequence
  exact realized

end Dada.Shared.Typing

namespace Dada.Shared.Typing

-- Empty slots remain allocated; absence is a separate outer Option at lookup.
abbrev SlotDescription := Option ValueType
abbrev Environment := List (VariableId × SlotDescription)

def Environment.WellFormed (environment : Environment) (classes : ClassTable) : Prop :=
  (environment.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    environment.all (fun entry => match entry.2 with
      | none => true
      | some ty => decide (Admissible classes ty)) = true

instance (environment : Environment) (classes : ClassTable) :
    Decidable (environment.WellFormed classes) := by
  unfold Environment.WellFormed
  infer_instance

def Environment.lookup (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId) :
    Option SlotDescription :=
  (environment.find? fun entry => entry.1 == name).map Prod.snd

def Environment.replace (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId)
    (description : SlotDescription) : Environment :=
  environment.map fun entry => if entry.1 = name then (name, description) else entry

def splitPlace : Place → VariableId × Path
  | .variable name => (name, [])
  | .field base name =>
      let (root, path) := splitPlace base
      (root, path ++ [name])

def placeFrom (root : VariableId) (path : Path) : Place :=
  path.foldl Place.field (.variable root)

theorem placeFrom_splitPlace (place : Place) :
    placeFrom (splitPlace place).1 (splitPlace place).2 = place := by
  induction place with
  | «variable» name => rfl
  | field base name ih =>
    simpa [splitPlace, placeFrom, List.foldl_append] using
      congrArg (fun p => Place.field p name) ih

-- Giving is a static operation: it never consults the heap or evaluation.
def give (classes : ClassTable) (environment : Environment) (place : Place) :
    Option (ValueType × Environment) := do
  let (root, path) := splitPlace place
  let source ← environment.lookup root
  let source ← source
  let result ← focus classes source path
  if result.permission = .shared then
    return (result, environment)
  else if path = [] then
    return (result, environment.replace root none)
  else
    let remaining ← emptyPath classes source path
    return (result, environment.replace root (some remaining))

def fieldDescription (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ValueType) (name : FieldName) :
    Option SlotDescription :=
  if Unique.Typing.negative ty.nominal [name] then some none
  else (focus classes ty [name]).map some

-- The well-formedness premises make the chapter's global convention explicit.
-- They inspect only finite static descriptions, not operational success.
mutual
inductive ExprTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Value → ValueType → Environment → Prop where
  | give {before after : Environment} {place : Place} {ty : ValueType} :
      before.WellFormed classes →
      Typing.give classes before place = some (ty, after) →
      Admissible classes ty → after.WellFormed classes →
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) ty after
  | giveShare {before after : Environment} {place : Place} {ty : ValueType} :
      before.WellFormed classes →
      Typing.give classes before place = some (ty, after) →
      Admissible classes ty → after.WellFormed classes →
      StructType classes ty →
      ExprTyped classes before (.giveShare place) ty.shared after
  | new {before after : Environment} {name : ClassName} {declaration : TypedClass}
      {arguments : List Value} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ classes →
      ArgsTyped classes before arguments (declaration.fields.map Prod.snd) after →
      Admissible classes (ValueType.whole name (initialPermission declaration.kind)) →
      (declaration.kind.isStruct = true →
        ∀ field ∈ declaration.fields, StructType classes field.2.toType) →
      ExprTyped classes before (.new name arguments)
        (ValueType.whole name (initialPermission declaration.kind)) after
  | weaken {before after : Environment} {value : Value} {ty other : ValueType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty after →
      Admissible classes other → Subtype classes ty other →
      ExprTyped classes before value other after

inductive ArgsTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → List Value → List FieldType → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment : Environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → ArgsTyped classes environment [] [] environment
  | cons {before middle after : Environment} {value : Value} {values : List Value}
      {field : FieldType} {fields : List FieldType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value field.toType middle →
      ArgsTyped classes middle values fields after →
      ArgsTyped classes before (value :: values) (field :: fields) after
end

-- Pattern order determines binding order; all field names must still be present.
inductive FieldBindings (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ValueType) : List (FieldName × VariableId) → Environment → Prop where
  | nil : FieldBindings classes ty [] []
  | cons {field : FieldName} {destination : VariableId} {description : SlotDescription}
      {fields : List (FieldName × VariableId)} {bindings : Environment} :
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings →
      FieldBindings classes ty ((field, destination) :: fields)
        ((destination, description) :: bindings)

inductive BindingTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Unpacking.Pattern → ValueType → Environment → Prop where
  | variable {environment : Environment} {name : VariableId} {ty : ValueType} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → Admissible classes ty →
      name ∉ environment.map Prod.fst →
      BindingTyped classes environment (.variable name) ty ((name, some ty) :: environment)
  | unpack {before : Environment} {ty : ValueType} {name : ClassName}
      {declaration : TypedClass} {fields : List (FieldName × VariableId)}
      {bindings : Environment} :
      before.WellFormed classes → Admissible classes ty →
      ty.permission = .given → ty.nominal.className = name → (name, declaration) ∈ classes →
      (fields.map Prod.fst).Perm (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) →
      (fields.map Prod.snd).Nodup →
      (∀ destination ∈ fields.map Prod.snd, destination ∉ before.map Prod.fst) →
      FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings →
      (bindings ++ before).WellFormed classes →
      BindingTyped classes before (.unpack name fields) ty (bindings ++ before)

inductive StatementTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Unpacking.Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | letValue {before middle after : Environment} {pattern : Unpacking.Pattern}
      {value : Value} {ty : ValueType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty middle →
      BindingTyped classes middle pattern ty after →
      StatementTyped classes before ⟨pattern, value⟩ after

inductive SequenceTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → List Unpacking.Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment : Environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → SequenceTyped classes environment [] environment
  | cons {before middle after : Environment} {statement : Unpacking.Statement}
      {rest : List Unpacking.Statement} :
      StatementTyped classes before statement middle →
      SequenceTyped classes middle rest after →
      SequenceTyped classes before (statement :: rest) after

def ProgramTyped (classes : ClassTable) (code : List Unpacking.Statement) : Prop :=
  classes.WellFormed ∧ ∃ finalEnvironment, SequenceTyped classes [] code finalEnvironment

theorem ArgsTyped.length (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values fields after) :
    values.length = fields.length := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | giveShare => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ rest => simpa using rest

theorem FieldBindings.keys (typed : FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings) :
    bindings.map Prod.fst = fields.map Prod.snd := by
  induction typed with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [ih]

-- Weakening cannot disguise an unsuccessful give as a typed give.
theorem ExprTyped.give_requires_operation
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .give place → ∃ result, Typing.give classes before place = some (result, after) := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give _ taken _ _ =>
    intro place equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, taken⟩
  | giveShare => intro place equality; cases equality
  | new => intro place equality; cases equality
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem failed_give_not_typed (failed : Typing.give classes environment place = none) :
    ¬ ExprTyped classes environment (.give place) ty after := by
  intro typed
  obtain ⟨result, succeeded⟩ := typed.give_requires_operation place rfl
  rw [failed] at succeeded
  contradiction

theorem ExprTyped.give_permission
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .give place → ∃ result,
      Typing.give classes before place = some (result, after) ∧
      result.permission = ty.permission := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give _ taken _ _ =>
    intro place equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, taken, rfl⟩
  | giveShare => intro place equality; cases equality
  | new => intro place equality; cases equality
  | weaken _ _ subtype ih =>
    intro place equality
    obtain ⟨result, taken, permission⟩ := ih place equality
    exact ⟨result, taken, permission.trans subtype.1⟩
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem ExprTyped.new_requires_arguments
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ name arguments, value = .new name arguments →
      ∃ declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
        ArgsTyped classes before arguments (declaration.fields.map Prod.snd) after := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => intro name arguments equality; cases equality
  | giveShare => intro name arguments equality; cases equality
  | new declared arguments _ _ _ =>
    intro name values equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, declared, arguments⟩
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem ExprTyped.giveShare_requires_struct
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .giveShare place → ∃ source,
      Typing.give classes before place = some (source, after) ∧ StructType classes source := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => intro place equality; cases equality
  | giveShare _ taken _ _ structTy =>
    intro place equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, taken, structTy⟩
  | new => intro place equality; cases equality
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

end Dada.Shared.Typing
