-- A counted trace records the number of statement transitions.
inductive StepsExactly (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Nat → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : StepsExactly classes configuration 0 configuration
  | step {before middle after : Configuration} {count : Nat} :
      Step classes before middle → StepsExactly classes middle count after →
      StepsExactly classes before (count + 1) after

theorem StepsExactly.steps (trace : StepsExactly classes before count after) :
    Steps classes before after := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | step first _ rest => exact .step first rest

theorem StepsExactly.length (trace : StepsExactly classes before count after) :
    before.code.length = count + after.code.length := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => simp
  | step first _ rest => have shorter := first.code_length; omega

theorem StepsExactly.trans (first : StepsExactly classes before count middle)
    (second : StepsExactly classes middle later after) :
    StepsExactly classes before (count + later) after := by
  induction first with
  | refl => simpa using second
  | step firstStep _ rest =>
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (StepsExactly.step firstStep (rest second))

theorem Steps.counted (trace : Steps classes before after) :
    ∃ count, StepsExactly classes before count after := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact ⟨0, .refl _⟩
  | step first _ rest =>
    obtain ⟨count, trace⟩ := rest
    exact ⟨count + 1, .step first trace⟩

end Dada.Unique.Unpacking

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

section FromExpressionSoundness

variable {classes : ClassTable}
variable (expressionSound : ∀ before value ty after,
  ExprTyped classes before value ty after → ExpressionSound classes before value ty after)

include expressionSound

theorem ConfigurationTyped.progress_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Unpacking.Step classes.erase configuration after := by
  obtain ⟨current, realized, sequence⟩ := typed
  rcases configuration with ⟨state, code⟩
  cases code with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons statement rest =>
    cases sequence with
    | cons first remaining =>
      cases first with
      | letValue expression binding =>
        have sound := expressionSound _ _ _ _ expression state [] realized
        obtain ⟨evaluated, object, evaluation⟩ := sound.1
        have current := sound.2 evaluated object evaluation
        obtain ⟨after, operation⟩ := binding.exists_bind current
        exact Or.inr ⟨⟨after, rest⟩, .letValue evaluation operation⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.preservation_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (step : Unpacking.Step classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment := by
  obtain ⟨current, realized, sequence⟩ := typed
  cases step with
  | letValue evaluation operation =>
    cases sequence with
    | cons first rest =>
      cases first with
      | letValue expression binding =>
        have evaluated := (expressionSound _ _ _ _ expression _ [] realized).2 _ _ evaluation
        exact ⟨_, binding.preserves_realization evaluated operation, rest⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.trace_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (trace : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact typed
  | step first _ rest =>
    exact rest (typed.preservation_of_expression expressionSound first)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finishes_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    ∃ final, Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration configuration.code.length final ∧
      final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] := by
  have decreasing : ∀ (count : Nat) (configuration : Unpacking.Configuration), configuration.code.length = count →
      ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment →
      ∃ final, Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration count final ∧
        final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] := by
    intro count
    induction count with
    | zero =>
      intro configuration empty typed
      have finished : configuration.finished := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp empty
      exact ⟨configuration, .refl _, finished, typed.finished finished⟩
    | succ count ih =>
      intro configuration length typed
      rcases typed.progress_of_expression expressionSound with finished | ⟨after, step⟩
      · have empty : configuration.code = [] := finished
        simp [empty] at length
      · have shorter := step.code_length
        have nextLength : after.code.length = count := by omega
        obtain ⟨final, rest, finished, realized⟩ := ih after nextLength
          (typed.preservation_of_expression expressionSound step)
        exact ⟨final, .step step rest, finished, realized⟩
  exact decreasing _ configuration rfl typed

end FromExpressionSoundness

-- The public results discharge the expression premise with the proved static
-- soundness theorem; no operational-success assumption appears here.
theorem expression_soundness
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before state pending) :
    (∃ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object) ∧
    (∀ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object →
      Realizes classes after result (pending ++ [(object, ty)])) := by
  have sound := typed.sound state pending realized
  refine ⟨sound.1, fun result object evaluated => ?_⟩
  exact (sound.2 result object evaluated).perm (by simpa using (List.perm_middle (a := (object, ty)) (l₁ := pending) (l₂ := [])).symm)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.progress
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Unpacking.Step classes.erase configuration after :=
  typed.progress_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.preservation
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (step : Unpacking.Step classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment :=
  typed.preservation_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound) step

theorem ConfigurationTyped.trace
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (steps : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment :=
  typed.trace_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound) steps

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finishes
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    ∃ final, Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration configuration.code.length final ∧
      final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] :=
  typed.finishes_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound)

-- Every finite execution prefix remains safe and can be completed. The counted
-- continuation gives exactly one transition per original statement overall.
theorem program_safety (classesWf : classes.WellFormed)
    (typed : SequenceTyped classes [] code finalEnvironment)
    (execution : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase ⟨State.empty, code⟩ configuration) :
    ¬ Unpacking.Stuck classes.erase configuration ∧
    (configuration.finished ∨ ∃ next, Unpacking.Step classes.erase configuration next) ∧
    ∃ final prefixLength,
      Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase ⟨State.empty, code⟩ prefixLength configuration ∧
      Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration configuration.code.length final ∧
      prefixLength + configuration.code.length = code.length ∧
      Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase ⟨State.empty, code⟩ code.length final ∧
      final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] := by
  have initial : ConfigurationTyped classes ⟨State.empty, code⟩ finalEnvironment :=
    ⟨[], Realizes.empty classesWf, typed⟩
  have current := initial.trace execution
  have progress := current.progress
  refine ⟨?_, progress, ?_⟩
  · intro stuck
    rcases progress with finished | next
    · exact stuck.1 finished
    · exact stuck.2 next
  · obtain ⟨final, completion, finished, realized⟩ := current.finishes
    obtain ⟨count, counted⟩ := execution.counted
    have length : count + configuration.code.length = code.length := counted.length.symm
    exact ⟨final, count, counted, completion, length,
      length ▸ counted.trans completion, finished, realized⟩

end Dada.Unique.Typing

import Unique.Soundness

namespace Dada.Unique.Unpacking

-- Patterns consume an expression result; they are not value expressions.
inductive Pattern where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | unpack (className : ClassName) (fields : List (FieldName × VariableId))
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Pattern.variables : Pattern → List VariableId
  | .variable name => [name]
  | .unpack _ fields => fields.map Prod.snd

structure Statement where
  pattern : Pattern
  value : Value
  deriving Repr

structure Configuration where
  state : State
  code : List Statement
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.code = []

-- Choose each named field exactly once, in pattern order. Empty slots are
-- transferred too. The empty case requires that no field was left behind.
inductive Transfer : List (FieldName × VariableId) → List (FieldName × Slot) → List (VariableId × Slot) → Prop where
  | nil : Transfer [] [] []
  | cons {field name slot pattern before after bindings} :
      Transfer pattern (before ++ after) bindings →
      Transfer ((field, name) :: pattern) (before ++ (field, slot) :: after)
        ((name, slot) :: bindings)

-- Binding itself neither evaluates an expression nor assumes an invariant.
inductive Bind (classes : Classes) : State → ObjectId → Pattern → State → Prop where
  | variable {state object name} :
      name ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst →
      Bind classes state object (.variable name) (state.bind name object)
  | unpack {before after variables nextId object className fields pattern bindings declaration} :
      (className, declaration) ∈ classes →
      fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields →
      (pattern.map Prod.fst).Nodup →
      (pattern.map Prod.snd).Nodup →
      (∀ name ∈ pattern.map Prod.snd, name ∉ variables.map Prod.fst) →
      Transfer pattern fields bindings →
      Bind classes ⟨before ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: after, variables, nextId⟩
        object (.unpack className pattern)
        ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩

inductive Step (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | letValue {before evaluated after pattern value object rest} :
      Eval classes before value evaluated object →
      Bind classes evaluated object pattern after →
      Step classes ⟨before, ⟨pattern, value⟩ :: rest⟩ ⟨after, rest⟩

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes before middle → Steps classes middle after → Steps classes before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes configuration after

theorem Bind.fresh (binding : Bind classes before object pattern after) :
    ∀ name ∈ pattern.variables, name ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases binding with
  | «variable» fresh => simpa [Pattern.variables] using fresh
  | unpack _ _ _ _ fresh _ => exact fresh

theorem Transfer.keys (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    bindings.map Prod.fst = pattern.map Prod.snd := by
  induction transfer with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ ih => simp [ih]

theorem Transfer.slots (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    (bindings.map Prod.snd).Perm (fields.map Prod.snd) := by
  induction transfer with
  | nil => exact .refl _
  | @cons field name slot pattern before after bindings _ ih =>
    simp only [List.map_append] at ih
    simpa using (List.Perm.cons slot ih).trans
      (List.perm_middle (a := slot) (l₁ := before.map Prod.snd)
        (l₂ := after.map Prod.snd)).symm

theorem Transfer.field_keys (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    (pattern.map Prod.fst).Perm (fields.map Prod.fst) := by
  induction transfer with
  | nil => exact .refl _
  | @cons field name slot pattern before after bindings _ ih =>
    simp only [List.map_append] at ih
    simpa using (List.Perm.cons field ih).trans
      (List.perm_middle (a := field) (l₁ := before.map Prod.fst)
        (l₂ := after.map Prod.fst)).symm

private abbrev slotReferences {K : Type} (slots : List (K × Slot)) : List ObjectId :=
  slots.filterMap (fun entry => entry.2)

theorem Transfer.references (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings) :
    (slotReferences bindings).Perm (slotReferences fields) := by
  simpa [slotReferences, List.filterMap_map, Function.comp_def] using
    transfer.slots.filterMap id

-- Relocating the fields changes where their references occur, not which
-- references remain. The consumed container is the separate pending root.
private theorem unpack_references
    (transfer : Transfer pattern fields bindings)
    (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (variables : List (VariableId × Slot))
    (nextId : Nat) (object : ObjectId) (className : ClassName) :
    (References ⟨before ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: after, variables, nextId⟩).Perm
      (References ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩) := by
  apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
  intro id
  have same := transfer.references.count_eq id
  simp only [References, List.filterMap_append, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons,
    List.count_append] at *
  change List.count id (slotReferences variables) +
      (List.count id (before.flatMap fun e => slotReferences e.2.fields) +
        (List.count id (slotReferences fields) +
          List.count id (after.flatMap fun e => slotReferences e.2.fields))) =
    (List.count id (slotReferences bindings) + List.count id (slotReferences variables)) +
      (List.count id (before.flatMap fun e => slotReferences e.2.fields) +
        List.count id (after.flatMap fun e => slotReferences e.2.fields))
  omega

theorem Bind.preserves_wellFormed
    (binding : Bind classes before object pattern after)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes before [object]) : WellFormed classes after := by
  cases binding with
  | «variable» fresh => exact wf.bind fresh
  | @unpack before after variables nextId object className fields pattern bindings declaration
      declared shape uniqueFields uniqueNames fresh transfer =>
    have subset : ∀ entry ∈ before ++ after,
        entry ∈ before ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: after := by
      intro entry member
      rcases List.mem_append.mp member with left | right
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ left
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ right)
    have keys : (before.map Prod.fst ++ object :: after.map Prod.fst).Nodup := by
      simpa using wf.objectKeys
    have removedKeys : (before.map Prod.fst ++ after.map Prod.fst).Nodup :=
      List.Nodup.sublist
        ((List.Sublist.refl _).append (List.sublist_cons_self _ _)) keys
    have removedAbsent : object ∉ before.map Prod.fst ++ after.map Prod.fst := by
      have perm := List.perm_middle (a := object) (l₁ := before.map Prod.fst)
        (l₂ := after.map Prod.fst)
      exact (List.nodup_cons.mp (perm.nodup_iff.mp keys)).1
    have refs := unpack_references transfer before after variables nextId object className
    have uniqueAfter : (object :: References
        ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩).Nodup := by
      exact (List.Perm.cons object refs).nodup_iff.mp wf.referencesUnique
    constructor
    · simpa using removedKeys
    · simp only [List.map_append, transfer.keys]
      apply List.nodup_append.mpr
      refine ⟨uniqueNames, wf.variableKeys, ?_⟩
      intro name member other otherMember equality
      subst other
      exact fresh name member otherMember
    · intro id data member
      exact wf.shapes id data (subset _ member)
    · intro id data member
      exact wf.bounds id data (subset _ member)
    · intro id data name target member field
      exact wf.older id data name target (subset _ member) field
    · exact (List.nodup_cons.mp uniqueAfter).2
    · intro id
      have complete := wf.referencesComplete id
      simp only [List.singleton_append, List.mem_cons, Allocated, List.map_append,
        List.map_cons, List.mem_append] at complete
      change id ∈ References ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩ ↔
        id ∈ (before ++ after).map Prod.fst
      by_cases same : id = object
      · subst id
        have noRef := (List.nodup_cons.mp uniqueAfter).1
        simp [noRef, List.map_append, removedAbsent]
      · rw [← refs.mem_iff]
        simpa [same, List.map_append] using complete

theorem Step.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  cases step with
  | letValue evaluation binding =>
    exact binding.preserves_wellFormed
      (evaluation.preserves_pending classesWf [] wf.with_empty)

theorem Steps.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (steps : Steps classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact wf
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (first.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf)

def embedStatement (statement : Dada.Unique.Statement) : Statement :=
  ⟨.variable statement.destination, statement.value⟩

def embedConfiguration (configuration : Dada.Unique.Configuration) : Configuration :=
  ⟨configuration.state, configuration.code.map embedStatement⟩

theorem embed_step (step : Dada.Unique.Step classes before after) :
    Step classes (embedConfiguration before) (embedConfiguration after) := by
  cases step with
  | letValue fresh evaluation => exact .letValue evaluation (.variable fresh)

-- There is no new transition available to a program containing only the old
-- variable patterns, even when the successor is not assumed to be embedded.
theorem reflect_step (step : Step classes (embedConfiguration before) after) :
    ∃ next, Dada.Unique.Step classes before next ∧ after = embedConfiguration next := by
  rcases before with ⟨state, code⟩
  cases code with
  | nil => cases step
  | cons statement rest =>
    rcases statement with ⟨destination, value⟩
    cases step with
    | letValue evaluation binding =>
      cases binding with
      | «variable» fresh => exact ⟨_, .letValue fresh evaluation, rfl⟩

theorem embed_steps (steps : Dada.Unique.Steps classes before after) :
    Steps classes (embedConfiguration before) (embedConfiguration after) := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | step first _ ih => exact .step (embed_step first) ih

theorem embed_finished : (embedConfiguration configuration).finished ↔ configuration.finished := by
  simp [embedConfiguration, Configuration.finished, Dada.Unique.Configuration.finished]

theorem Step.code_length (step : Step classes before after) :
    before.code.length = after.code.length + 1 := by
  cases step
  rfl

end Dada.Unique.Unpacking

import Unique.Unpacking

namespace Dada.Unique.Unpacking

def exampleClasses : Classes :=
  [("Token", ⟨[]⟩), ("Pair", ⟨["left", "right"]⟩)]

def pairObject : Object :=
  ⟨"Pair", [("left", some 0), ("right", some 1)]⟩

def partialPair : Object :=
  ⟨"Pair", [("left", none), ("right", some 1)]⟩

def tokenObjects : List (ObjectId × Object) :=
  [(1, ⟨"Token", []⟩), (0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)]

def constructed : State :=
  ⟨(2, pairObject) :: tokenObjects, [("p", some 2)], 3⟩

def movedLeft : State :=
  ⟨(2, partialPair) :: tokenObjects, [("taken", some 0), ("p", some 2)], 3⟩

def takenPair : State :=
  ⟨(2, partialPair) :: tokenObjects, [("taken", some 0), ("p", none)], 3⟩

def unpacked : State :=
  ⟨tokenObjects,
    [("left", none), ("right", some 1), ("taken", some 0), ("p", none)], 3⟩

def unpackingProgram : List Statement :=
  [⟨.variable "p", .new "Pair" [.new "Token" [], .new "Token" []]⟩,
    ⟨.variable "taken", .give (.field (.variable "p") "left")⟩,
    ⟨.unpack "Pair" [("left", "left"), ("right", "right")], .give (.variable "p")⟩]

private theorem construct_pair : Eval exampleClasses State.empty
    (.new "Pair" [.new "Token" [], .new "Token" []])
    ⟨(2, pairObject) :: tokenObjects, [], 3⟩ 2 := by
  let first := State.empty.allocate "Token" [] []
  let second := first.allocate "Token" [] []
  apply Eval.new (declaration := ⟨["left", "right"]⟩)
      (evaluated := second) (objects := [0, 1])
  · simp [exampleClasses]
  · apply EvalArgs.cons (middle := first) (object := 0)
    · exact Eval.new (by simp [exampleClasses]) (.nil _) rfl (by simp [State.empty])
    · apply EvalArgs.cons (middle := second) (object := 1)
      · exact Eval.new (by simp [exampleClasses]) (.nil _) rfl (by decide)
      · exact EvalArgs.nil _
  · rfl
  · decide

private theorem move_left : Eval exampleClasses constructed
    (.give (.field (.variable "p") "left"))
    ⟨(2, partialPair) :: tokenObjects, [("p", some 2)], 3⟩ 0 := by
  apply Eval.give (source := .field 2 "left")
  · apply Resolve.field (parent := 2) (data := pairObject)
    · exact Resolve.variable (by decide)
    · decide
    · decide
  · exact Take.field [("p", some 2)] 3 [] tokenObjects 2 "Pair" []
      [("right", some 1)] "left" 0

private theorem take_pair : Eval exampleClasses movedLeft
    (.give (.variable "p")) takenPair 2 := by
  exact Eval.give (Resolve.variable (by decide))
    (Take.variable ((2, partialPair) :: tokenObjects) 3 [("taken", some 0)] [] "p" 2)

private theorem unpack_pair : Bind exampleClasses takenPair 2
    (.unpack "Pair" [("left", "left"), ("right", "right")]) unpacked := by
  apply Bind.unpack (before := []) (after := tokenObjects)
    (declaration := ⟨["left", "right"]⟩)
    (bindings := [("left", none), ("right", some 1)])
  · simp [exampleClasses]
  · rfl
  · decide
  · decide
  · decide
  · exact Transfer.cons (before := []) (Transfer.cons (before := []) .nil)

theorem unpacking_execution : Steps exampleClasses ⟨State.empty, unpackingProgram⟩
    ⟨unpacked, []⟩ := by
  apply Steps.step (middle := ⟨constructed, unpackingProgram.tail⟩)
  · exact Step.letValue construct_pair (.variable (by decide))
  · apply Steps.step (middle := ⟨movedLeft, unpackingProgram.tail.tail⟩)
    · exact Step.letValue move_left (.variable (by decide))
    · exact .step (.letValue take_pair unpack_pair) (.refl _)

theorem moved_field_has_no_value :
    ¬ ∃ after object, Eval exampleClasses unpacked (.give (.variable "left")) after object := by
  rintro ⟨after, object, evaluation⟩
  cases evaluation with
  | give resolved _ =>
    cases resolved with
    | «variable» stored => simp [unpacked] at stored

-- ANCHOR: unpack_after_move
example : Steps exampleClasses ⟨State.empty, unpackingProgram⟩ ⟨unpacked, []⟩ ∧
    (Configuration.mk unpacked []).finished ∧
    ¬ ∃ after object, Eval exampleClasses unpacked (.give (.variable "left")) after object := by
  exact ⟨unpacking_execution, rfl, moved_field_has_no_value⟩
-- ANCHOR_END: unpack_after_move

-- Reordering the names reorders the new bindings, without changing their slots.
example : Bind exampleClasses takenPair 2
    (.unpack "Pair" [("right", "r"), ("left", "l")])
    ⟨tokenObjects, [("r", some 1), ("l", none), ("taken", some 0), ("p", none)], 3⟩ := by
  apply Bind.unpack (before := []) (after := tokenObjects)
    (declaration := ⟨["left", "right"]⟩)
    (bindings := [("r", some 1), ("l", none)])
  · simp [exampleClasses]
  · rfl
  · decide
  · decide
  · decide
  · exact Transfer.cons (before := [("left", none)]) (after := [])
      (Transfer.cons (before := []) .nil)

-- A fieldless object can be consumed without producing any bindings.
example : Bind exampleClasses ⟨[(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)], [], 1⟩ 0
    (.unpack "Token" []) ⟨[], [], 1⟩ := by
  exact Bind.unpack (before := []) (after := []) (by simp [exampleClasses])
    rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by simp) .nil

-- Empty variables remain allocated: an unpack cannot reuse p as a fresh name.
example : ¬ ∃ after, Bind exampleClasses takenPair 2
    (.unpack "Pair" [("left", "p"), ("right", "right")]) after := by
  rintro ⟨after, binding⟩
  have fresh := binding.fresh "p" (by decide)
  exact fresh (by decide)

example : WellFormed exampleClasses unpacked := by
  have classesWf : ClassesWellFormed exampleClasses := by
    simp [ClassesWellFormed, exampleClasses]
    rintro name declaration (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) <;> decide
  exact unpacking_execution.preserves_wellFormed classesWf (WellFormed.empty _)

end Dada.Unique.Unpacking

import Unique.ViewSoundness

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

def IncomparableEntries (left right : Entry) : Prop :=
  ¬left.path <+: right.path ∧ ¬right.path <+: left.path

theorem entriesDisjoint_iff_pairwise (entries : List Entry) :
    entriesDisjoint entries = true ↔ entries.Pairwise IncomparableEntries := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp [entriesDisjoint]
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    simp [entriesDisjoint, List.pairwise_cons, ← ih,
      List.all_eq_true, IncomparableEntries, Bool.eq_false_iff, List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix]

theorem prefix_cons_iff {field other : FieldName} {left right : Path} :
    field :: left <+: other :: right ↔ field = other ∧ left <+: right := by
  rw [← List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix]
  simp only [List.isPrefixOf_cons_cons, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq,
    List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix]

theorem selected_disjoint {entries : List Entry} (disjoint : entriesDisjoint entries = true)
    (field : FieldName) : entriesDisjoint (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])) = true := by
  apply (entriesDisjoint_iff_pairwise _).mpr
  apply List.Pairwise.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field]) _
    ((entriesDisjoint_iff_pairwise _).mp disjoint)
  intro original other incomparable selected found selectedOther foundOther
  have firstEq := Entry.dropPrefix_eq_some found
  have secondEq := Entry.dropPrefix_eq_some foundOther
  simpa [IncomparableEntries, firstEq, secondEq, prefix_cons_iff] using incomparable

theorem prepended_disjoint {entries : List Entry} (disjoint : entriesDisjoint entries = true)
    (field : FieldName) : entriesDisjoint (entries.map (Entry.prepend [field])) = true := by
  apply (entriesDisjoint_iff_pairwise _).mpr
  apply List.Pairwise.map (Entry.prepend [field]) _ ((entriesDisjoint_iff_pairwise _).mp disjoint)
  intro left right incomparable
  simpa [IncomparableEntries, prefix_cons_iff] using incomparable

theorem selected_valid {classes : ClassTable} {name : ClassName} {entries : List Entry}
    (valid : entries.all (Entry.valid classes name) = true)
    (fieldLookup : classAt classes name [field] = some target)
    (noRoot : Entry.negative [] ∉ entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])) :
    (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])).all (Entry.valid classes target) = true := by
  apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
  intro entry selected
  obtain ⟨original, member, dropped⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp selected
  have eq := Entry.dropPrefix_eq_some dropped
  have originalValid := List.all_eq_true.mp valid original member
  have validPath : (classAt classes target entry.path).isSome = true := by
    have pathValid := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp originalValid).1
    rw [eq, Entry.path_prepend, classAt_append, fieldLookup] at pathValid
    exact pathValid
  cases entry with
  | positive path => simpa [Entry.valid, Entry.path] using validPath
  | negative path =>
    have nonempty : path ≠ [] := by
      intro empty
      subst path
      exact noRoot (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨original, member, dropped⟩)
    simp only [Entry.path] at validPath
    simp [Entry.valid, Entry.path, validPath, nonempty]

theorem prepended_valid {classes : ClassTable} {name target : ClassName} {entries : List Entry}
    (valid : entries.all (Entry.valid classes target) = true)
    (fieldLookup : classAt classes name [field] = some target) :
    (entries.map (Entry.prepend [field])).all (Entry.valid classes name) = true := by
  apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
  intro entry member
  obtain ⟨original, present, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  have originalValid := List.all_eq_true.mp valid original present
  have validPath : (classAt classes name ([field] ++ original.path)).isSome = true := by
    rw [classAt_append, fieldLookup]
    exact (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp originalValid).1
  cases original <;> simpa [Entry.valid, Entry.prepend, Entry.path] using validPath

private theorem lookup_member {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    {entries : List (K × V)} {key : K} {value : V}
    (found : entries.lookup key = some value) : (key, value) ∈ entries := by
  obtain ⟨before, after, rfl, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp found
  simp

private theorem lookup_unique_member {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    {entries : List (K × V)} {key : K} {value : V}
    (unique : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup) (member : (key, value) ∈ entries) :
    entries.lookup key = some value := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp at member
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨head, data⟩
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at unique
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same; simp
    · have different : key ≠ head := by
        intro same
        exact unique.1 (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, later, same⟩)
      rw [List.lookup_cons, show (key == head) = false from beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different]
      exact ih unique.2 later

def normalizedChild (classes : ClassTable) (fuel : Nat) (entries : List Entry)
    (field : FieldName × ClassName) : List Entry :=
  let selected := entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field.1])
  if selected.isEmpty then []
  else if selected.contains (.negative []) then [.negative [field.1]]
  else (normalizeEntries classes fuel field.2 selected).map (Entry.prepend [field.1])

theorem normalizedChild_prefix (classes : ClassTable) (fuel : Nat) (entries : List Entry)
    (field : FieldName × ClassName) (entry : Entry)
    (member : entry ∈ normalizedChild classes fuel entries field) :
    ∃ path, entry.path = field.1 :: path := by
  unfold normalizedChild at member
  dsimp only at member
  split at member
  · simp at member
  · split at member
    · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at member
      subst entry
      exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨original, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
      exact ⟨original.path, Entry.path_prepend _ _⟩

theorem children_disjoint {fields : List (FieldName × ClassName)}
    (unique : (fields.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    (each : ∀ field ∈ fields,
      entriesDisjoint (normalizedChild classes fuel entries field) = true) :
    entriesDisjoint (fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries)) = true := by
  apply (entriesDisjoint_iff_pairwise _).mpr
  apply List.pairwise_flatMap.mpr
  constructor
  · intro field member
    exact (entriesDisjoint_iff_pairwise _).mp (each field member)
  · have names := List.pairwise_map.mp unique
    apply names.imp
    intro left right different leftEntry leftMember rightEntry rightMember
    obtain ⟨leftPath, leftEq⟩ := normalizedChild_prefix _ _ _ _ _ leftMember
    obtain ⟨rightPath, rightEq⟩ := normalizedChild_prefix _ _ _ _ _ rightMember
    simp only [IncomparableEntries, leftEq, rightEq, prefix_cons_iff]
    exact ⟨fun both => different both.1, fun both => different both.1.symm⟩

theorem normalizeEntries_wellFormed {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    (fuel : Nat) {name : ClassName} {entries : List Entry}
    (declared : (classes.lookup name).isSome = true)
    (valid : entries.all (Entry.valid classes name) = true)
    (disjoint : entriesDisjoint entries = true) :
    (normalizeEntries classes fuel name entries).all (Entry.valid classes name) = true ∧
      entriesDisjoint (normalizeEntries classes fuel name entries) = true := by
  induction fuel generalizing name entries with
  | zero =>
    rw [normalizeEntries]
    split
    · simp [Entry.valid, Entry.path, classAt, entriesDisjoint]
    · split
      · exact ⟨valid, disjoint⟩
      · split
        · simp [Entry.valid, Entry.path, classAt, entriesDisjoint]
        · exact ⟨valid, disjoint⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [normalizeEntries]
    split
    · simp [Entry.valid, Entry.path, classAt, entriesDisjoint]
    · split
      · exact ⟨valid, disjoint⟩
      next declaration found =>
        split
        · simp [Entry.valid, Entry.path, classAt, entriesDisjoint]
        · dsimp only
          have declarationMember := lookup_member found
          have fieldsWF := classesWF.2 _ declarationMember
          have each : ∀ field ∈ declaration.fields,
              (normalizedChild classes fuel entries field).all (Entry.valid classes name) = true ∧
              entriesDisjoint (normalizedChild classes fuel entries field) = true := by
            intro field member
            rcases field with ⟨field, target⟩
            have fieldFound := lookup_unique_member fieldsWF.1 member
            have fieldClass : classAt classes name [field] = some target := by
              simp [classAt, found, fieldFound]
            obtain ⟨⟨_, targetDeclaration⟩, targetMember, targetEq⟩ :=
              List.mem_map.mp (fieldsWF.2 _ member)
            simp only at targetEq
            subst targetEq
            have targetFound := lookup_unique_member classesWF.1 targetMember
            unfold normalizedChild
            dsimp only
            split
            · simp [entriesDisjoint]
            · split
              · simp [Entry.valid, Entry.path, fieldClass, entriesDisjoint]
              next noRoot =>
                have child := ih (by simp [targetFound])
                  (selected_valid valid fieldClass
                    (fun root => noRoot (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr root)))
                  (selected_disjoint disjoint field)
                exact ⟨prepended_valid child.1 fieldClass, prepended_disjoint child.2 field⟩
          have childrenWF :
              (declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries)).all
                (Entry.valid classes name) = true ∧
              entriesDisjoint (declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries)) = true := by
            constructor
            · apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
              intro entry present
              obtain ⟨field, member, childMember⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp present
              exact List.all_eq_true.mp (each field member).1 entry childMember
            · exact children_disjoint fieldsWF.1 (fun field member => (each field member).2)
          split
          · simp [Entry.valid, Entry.path, classAt, entriesDisjoint]
          · exact childrenWF

theorem normalize_wellFormed {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {ty : ViewType} (wf : ty.WellFormed classes) : (normalize classes ty).WellFormed classes := by
  refine ⟨wf.1, ?_⟩
  exact normalizeEntries_wellFormed classesWF _ wf.1 wf.2.1 wf.2.2

private theorem flatMap_congr_member {A B : Type} {entries : List A} {left right : A → List B}
    (same : ∀ entry ∈ entries, left entry = right entry) : entries.flatMap left = entries.flatMap right := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, same entry (by simp)]
    rw [ih (fun member present => same member (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ present))]

theorem normalizeEntries_permutation {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    (fuel : Nat) {name : ClassName} {entries other : List Entry}
    (declared : (classes.lookup name).isSome = true)
    (permutation : entries.Perm other)
    (bounded : ∀ entry ∈ entries, entry.path.length < fuel) :
    normalizeEntries classes fuel name entries = normalizeEntries classes fuel name other := by
  induction fuel generalizing name entries other with
  | zero =>
    have empty : entries = [] := by
      cases entries with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons entry rest => have impossible := bounded entry (by simp); omega
    subst entries
    have otherEmpty : other = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using permutation.length_eq.symm)
    subst other
    rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [normalizeEntries, normalizeEntries]
    rw [← permutation.contains_eq (a := .positive [])]
    split
    · rfl
    · cases found : classes.lookup name with
      | none => simp [found] at declared
      | some declaration =>
        simp only
        rw [← permutation.isEmpty_eq]
        split
        · rfl
        · have declarationMember := lookup_member found
          have fieldsWF := classesWF.2 _ declarationMember
          have childrenEq : declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries) =
              declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel other) := by
            apply flatMap_congr_member
            intro field member
            rcases field with ⟨field,target⟩
            have selectedPerm := permutation.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])
            unfold normalizedChild
            dsimp only
            rw [← selectedPerm.isEmpty_eq, ← selectedPerm.contains_eq (a := .negative [])]
            split
            · rfl
            · split
              · rfl
              · congr 1
                apply ih
                · obtain ⟨⟨_, targetDeclaration⟩, targetMember, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp (fieldsWF.2 _ member)
                  simp only at same
                  subst same
                  simp [lookup_unique_member classesWF.1 targetMember]
                · exact selectedPerm
                · intro entry selected
                  obtain ⟨original, present, dropped⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp selected
                  have eq := Entry.dropPrefix_eq_some dropped
                  have bound := bounded original present
                  rw [eq, Entry.path_prepend] at bound
                  simpa using bound
          change (let children := declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries)
                  if !declaration.fields.isEmpty && declaration.fields.all
                    (fun field => children.contains (.positive [field.1])) then [.positive []] else children) =
            (let children := declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel other)
             if !declaration.fields.isEmpty && declaration.fields.all
               (fun field => children.contains (.positive [field.1])) then [.positive []] else children)
          rw [childrenEq]

theorem entryDepth_bounds (entries : List Entry) (initial : Nat) :
    initial ≤ entries.foldl (fun depth entry => max depth entry.path.length) initial ∧
      ∀ entry ∈ entries, entry.path.length ≤
        entries.foldl (fun depth entry => max depth entry.path.length) initial := by
  induction entries generalizing initial with
  | nil => simp
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨start, bounds⟩ := ih (max initial entry.path.length)
    constructor
    · exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_left _ _) start
    · intro other member
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with rfl | later
      · exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_max_right _ _) start
      · exact bounds other later

theorem entryDepth_permutation {entries other : List Entry} (permutation : entries.Perm other)
    (initial : Nat) :
    entries.foldl (fun depth entry => max depth entry.path.length) initial =
      other.foldl (fun depth entry => max depth entry.path.length) initial := by
  induction permutation generalizing initial with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry _ ih => exact ih _
  | swap left right rest => simp [Nat.max_assoc, Nat.max_left_comm, Nat.max_comm]
  | trans _ _ first second => exact (first initial).trans (second initial)

theorem normalize_permutation {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {name : ClassName} {entries other : List Entry}
    (declared : (classes.lookup name).isSome = true) (permutation : entries.Perm other) :
    normalize classes ⟨name, entries⟩ = normalize classes ⟨name, other⟩ := by
  unfold normalize
  dsimp only
  rw [← entryDepth_permutation permutation 0]
  congr 1
  apply normalizeEntries_permutation classesWF _ declared permutation
  intro entry member
  exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((entryDepth_bounds entries 0).2 entry member)

end Dada.Unique.Typing

private theorem pair_path_cases {path : Path} {name : ClassName}
 (h : classAt viewClasses "Pair" path = some name) :
 (path = [] ∧ name = "Pair") ∨
 (path = ["left"] ∧ name = "Token") ∨
 (path = ["right"] ∧ name = "Token") := by
 cases path with
 | nil => simp [classAt] at h; simp [h]
 | cons f rest =>
   by_cases left : f = "left"
   · subst f
     cases rest with
     | nil => simp [classAt, viewClasses, List.lookup] at h; simp [h]
     | cons g tail => simp [classAt, viewClasses, List.lookup] at h
   · by_cases right : f = "right"
     · subst f
       cases rest with
       | nil => simp [classAt, viewClasses, List.lookup] at h; simp [h]
       | cons g tail => simp [classAt, viewClasses, List.lookup] at h
     · have leftb : (f == "left") = false := by simp [left]
       have rightb : (f == "right") = false := by simp [right]
       simp [classAt, viewClasses, List.lookup, leftb, rightb] at h

private theorem pair_view_full (ty : ViewType) (base : ty.className = "Pair")
 (left : Pos viewClasses ty ["left"] ∨ Neg ty ["left"])
 (right : Pos viewClasses ty ["right"] ∨ Neg ty ["right"]) : Full viewClasses ty := by
 intro path _ name declaration atPath atClass field member
 have casesPath :
   (path = [] ∧ name = "Pair") ∨
   (path = ["left"] ∧ name = "Token") ∨
   (path = ["right"] ∧ name = "Token") := by
   exact pair_path_cases (by simpa [base] using atPath)
 rcases casesPath with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
 · have hd : declaration = ⟨[("left", "Token"), ("right", "Token")]⟩ :=
     (Option.some.inj atClass).symm
   subst declaration
   simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at member
   rcases member with rfl | rfl
   · exact left
   · exact right
 · have hd : declaration = ⟨[]⟩ := (Option.some.inj atClass).symm
   subst declaration
   exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil member)
 · have hd : declaration = ⟨[]⟩ := (Option.some.inj atClass).symm
   subst declaration
   exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil member)

private theorem box_path_cases {path : Path} {name : ClassName}
 (h : classAt viewClasses "Box" path = some name) :
 (path = [] ∧ name = "Box") ∨
 (path = ["item"] ∧ name = "Pair") ∨
 (path = ["item", "left"] ∧ name = "Token") ∨
 (path = ["item", "right"] ∧ name = "Token") := by
 cases path with
 | nil => simp [classAt] at h; simp [h]
 | cons f rest =>
   by_cases item : f = "item"
   · subst f
     change classAt viewClasses "Pair" rest = some name at h
     rcases pair_path_cases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ <;> simp
   · have itemb : (f == "item") = false := by simp [item]
     simp [classAt, viewClasses, List.lookup, itemb] at h

private theorem box_hole_full : Full viewClasses
    ⟨"Box", [.negative ["item", "left"], .positive ["item", "right"]]⟩ := by
 intro path _ name declaration atPath atClass field member
 rcases box_path_cases atPath with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
 · have hd : declaration = ⟨[("item", "Pair")]⟩ := (Option.some.inj atClass).symm
   subst declaration
   have hf : field = ("item", "Pair") := by simpa using member
   subst field
   decide
 · have hd : declaration = ⟨[("left", "Token"), ("right", "Token")]⟩ :=
     (Option.some.inj atClass).symm
   subst declaration
   simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at member
   rcases member with rfl | rfl <;> decide
 · have hd : declaration = ⟨[]⟩ := (Option.some.inj atClass).symm
   subst declaration
   exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil member)
 · have hd : declaration = ⟨[]⟩ := (Option.some.inj atClass).symm
   subst declaration
   exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil member)

private theorem view_fullness :
    Full viewClasses (.whole "Pair") ∧
    ¬ Full viewClasses ⟨"Pair", [.positive ["left"]]⟩ ∧
    Full viewClasses ⟨"Pair", [.negative ["left"], .positive ["right"]]⟩ ∧
    ¬ Full viewClasses ⟨"Box", [.negative ["item", "left"]]⟩ ∧
    Full viewClasses ⟨"Box", [.negative ["item", "left"], .positive ["item", "right"]]⟩ := by
 refine ⟨pair_view_full _ rfl (by decide) (by decide), ?_,
   pair_view_full _ rfl (by decide) (by decide), ?_, box_hole_full⟩
 · intro full
   have status := full [] (by decide) "Pair"
     ⟨[("left", "Token"), ("right", "Token")]⟩ rfl rfl ("right", "Token") (by simp)

 · intro full

   exact absent status

private theorem normalizeEntries_whole (classes : ClassTable) (fuel : Nat) (name : ClassName) :
    normalizeEntries classes fuel name [.positive []] = [.positive []] := by
  rw [normalizeEntries]
  simp

private theorem normalizeEntries_empty {classes : ClassTable} {fuel : Nat} {name : ClassName}
    {declaration : TypedClass} (found : classes.lookup name = some declaration) :
    normalizeEntries classes fuel name [] =
      if declaration.fields.isEmpty then [.positive []] else [] := by
  rw [normalizeEntries]
  simp only [List.contains_nil, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, found,
    List.isEmpty_nil, Bool.and_true]
  split
  · rfl
  next nonempty =>
    cases fuel with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ fuel =>
      dsimp only
      simp only [List.filterMap_nil, List.isEmpty_nil, ↓reduceIte]
      have emptyChildren : declaration.fields.flatMap (fun _ => ([] : List Entry)) = [] :=
        List.flatMap_eq_nil_iff.mpr (by simp)
      rw [emptyChildren]
      have absent : declaration.fields.all (fun _ => false) = false := by
        apply List.all_eq_false.mpr
        obtain ⟨field, member⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil declaration.fields
          (fun eq => nonempty (by simp [eq]))
        exact ⟨field, member, by simp⟩
      simp only [List.contains_nil, absent, Bool.and_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]

private def Stable (classes : ClassTable) (name : ClassName) (entries : List Entry) : Prop :=
  ∀ fuel, (∀ entry ∈ entries, entry.path.length < fuel) →
    normalizeEntries classes fuel name entries = entries

private theorem stable_whole (classes : ClassTable) (name : ClassName) :
    Stable classes name [.positive []] := by
  intro fuel _
  exact normalizeEntries_whole _ _ _

private theorem lookup_mem {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    {entries : List (K × V)} {key : K} {value : V}
    (found : entries.lookup key = some value) : (key, value) ∈ entries := by
  obtain ⟨before, after, rfl, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp found
  simp

private theorem lookup_member {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    {entries : List (K × V)} {key : K} {value : V}
    (unique : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup) (member : (key, value) ∈ entries) :
    entries.lookup key = some value := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp at member
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨head, data⟩
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at unique
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same; simp
    · have different : key ≠ head := by
        intro same
        exact unique.1 (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, later, same⟩)
      rw [List.lookup_cons, show (key == head) = false from beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different]
      exact ih unique.2 later

private theorem normalizedChild_stable {classes : ClassTable} {firstFuel secondFuel : Nat}
    {fields : List (FieldName × ClassName)} {entries : List Entry}
    (unique : (fields.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    {field : FieldName × ClassName} (member : field ∈ fields)
    (stable : (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field.1])).isEmpty ≠ true →
      (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field.1])).contains (.negative []) ≠ true →
      Stable classes field.2
        (normalizeEntries classes firstFuel field.2 (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field.1]))))
    (bounded : ∀entry ∈ fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes firstFuel entries),
      entry.path.length < secondFuel + 1) :
    normalizedChild classes secondFuel
      (fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes firstFuel entries)) field =
      normalizedChild classes firstFuel entries field := by
  have selected := normalizedChildren_select unique field member classes firstFuel entries
  generalize childrenEq : fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes firstFuel entries) = children at *
  unfold normalizedChild
  dsimp only
  rw [selected]
  unfold normalizedChildBody
  dsimp only
  split
  · simp
  next notEmpty =>
    split
    · simp
    next noRoot =>
      split
      next empty =>
        have empty := List.isEmpty_iff.mp empty
        simp [empty]
      next =>
        split
        next impossible =>
          exact False.elim (noRoot (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr
            (normalizeEntries_negative (List.contains_iff_mem.mp impossible))))
        next =>
          rw [stable notEmpty noRoot secondFuel]
          intro entry entryMember
          have childMember : entry.prepend [field.1] ∈ normalizedChild classes firstFuel entries field := by
            unfold normalizedChild
            dsimp only
            split
            next empty =>
              have empty := List.isEmpty_iff.mp empty
              simp [empty] at *
            next =>
              exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨entry, entryMember, rfl⟩
          have bound := bounded (entry.prepend [field.1]) (by
            rw [←childrenEq]
            exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨field, member, childMember⟩)
          simp only [Entry.path_prepend, List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at bound
          omega


private theorem flatMap_congr_member {A B : Type} {entries : List A} {left right : A → List B}
    (equal : ∀entry ∈ entries, left entry = right entry) :
    entries.flatMap left = entries.flatMap right := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
    rw [equal entry (by simp), ih (fun other member => equal other (by simp [member]))]

private theorem normalizeEntries_stable {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    (fuel : Nat) {name : ClassName} {entries : List Entry}
    (declared : (classes.lookup name).isSome = true)
    (valid : entries.all (Entry.valid classes name) = true)
    (disjoint : entriesDisjoint entries = true)
    (bounded : ∀ entry ∈ entries, entry.path.length < fuel) :
    Stable classes name (normalizeEntries classes fuel name entries) := by
  induction fuel generalizing name entries with
  | zero =>
    have empty : entries = [] := by
      cases entries with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons entry rest => have impossible := bounded entry (by simp); omega
    subst entries
    cases found : classes.lookup name with
    | none => simp [found] at declared
    | some declaration =>
      rw [normalizeEntries_empty found]
      split
      · exact stable_whole _ _
      next nonempty =>
        intro secondFuel _
        rw [normalizeEntries_empty found]
        simp [nonempty]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [normalizeEntries]
    split
    · exact stable_whole _ _
    next noWhole =>
      cases found : classes.lookup name with
      | none => simp [found] at declared
      | some declaration =>
        dsimp only
        split
        · exact stable_whole _ _
        next notEmpty =>
          have declarationMember := lookup_mem found
          have fieldsWF := classesWF.2 _ declarationMember
          have fieldsNonempty : declaration.fields.isEmpty = false := by
            apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
            intro fieldsEmpty
            have entriesEmpty := empty_class_entries found (List.isEmpty_iff.mp fieldsEmpty)
              valid (fun h => noWhole (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr h))
            exact notEmpty (by simp [fieldsEmpty, entriesEmpty])
          have each : ∀ field ∈ declaration.fields,
              (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field.1])).isEmpty ≠ true →
              (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field.1])).contains (.negative []) ≠ true →
              Stable classes field.2 (normalizeEntries classes fuel field.2
                (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field.1]))) := by
            intro field member _ noNegative
            rcases field with ⟨field,target⟩
            have fieldFound := lookup_member fieldsWF.1 member
            have fieldClass : classAt classes name [field] = some target := by
              simp [classAt, found, fieldFound]
            obtain ⟨⟨_, targetDeclaration⟩, targetMember, same⟩ :=
              List.mem_map.mp (fieldsWF.2 _ member)
            simp only at same
            subst same
            apply ih
            · simp [lookup_member classesWF.1 targetMember]
            · exact selected_valid valid fieldClass
                (fun h => noNegative (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr h))
            · exact selected_disjoint disjoint field
            · intro entry selected
              obtain ⟨source, member, selected⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp selected
              have bound := bounded source member
              rw [Entry.dropPrefix_eq_some selected, Entry.path_prepend] at bound
              simpa using bound
          split
          · exact stable_whole _ _
          next notComplete =>
            change Stable classes name
              (declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries))
            intro secondFuel outputBound
            rw [normalizeEntries]
            have noRoot := (normalizedChildren_no_root declaration.fields classes fuel entries).1
            have noRootBool : (declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries)).contains
                (.positive []) = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
                  (fun h => noRoot (List.contains_iff_mem.mp h))
            rw [noRootBool]
            simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, found, fieldsNonempty, Bool.false_and]
            cases secondFuel with
            | zero => rfl
            | succ secondFuel =>
              dsimp only
              have childrenEq : declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes secondFuel
                    (declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries))) =
                  declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries) := by
                apply flatMap_congr_member
                intro field member
                exact normalizedChild_stable fieldsWF.1 member (each field member) outputBound
              change (if (!false && declaration.fields.all (fun field =>
                  (declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes secondFuel
                    (declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries)))).contains
                      (.positive [field.1]))) = true then [.positive []]
                else declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes secondFuel
                  (declaration.fields.flatMap (normalizedChild classes fuel entries)))) = _
              rw [childrenEq]
              apply ite_eq_right
              unfold normalizedChild
              simpa only [fieldsNonempty] using notComplete


theorem normalize_idempotent {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {ty : ViewType} (wf : ty.WellFormed classes) :
    normalize classes (normalize classes ty) = normalize classes ty := by
  have stable := normalizeEntries_stable classesWF
    (ty.entries.foldl (fun depth entry => max depth entry.path.length) 0 + 1)
    wf.1 wf.2.1 wf.2.2 (fun entry member =>
      Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((entryDepth_bounds ty.entries 0).2 entry member))
  have eq := stable ((normalize classes ty).entries.foldl
    (fun depth entry => max depth entry.path.length) 0 + 1) (fun entry member =>
      Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((entryDepth_bounds (normalize classes ty).entries 0).2 entry member))
  exact congrArg (ViewType.mk ty.className) eq

end Dada.Unique.Typing

private theorem disjoint_pair {entries : List Entry}
    (disjoint : entriesDisjoint entries = true) {left right : Entry}
    (leftMem : left ∈ entries) (rightMem : right ∈ entries) (different : left ≠ right) :
    ¬left.path <+: right.path ∧ ¬right.path <+: left.path := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp at leftMem
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    simp only [entriesDisjoint, Bool.and_eq_true] at disjoint
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp leftMem with rfl | leftTail
    · have rightMem := (List.mem_cons.mp rightMem).resolve_left (Ne.symm different)
      have h := List.all_eq_true.mp disjoint.1 right rightMem
      have h := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h
      exact ⟨fun pre => by simpa [List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr pre] using h.1,
        fun pre => by simpa [List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr pre] using h.2⟩
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp rightMem with rfl | rightMem
      · have h := List.all_eq_true.mp disjoint.1 left leftTail
        have h : ¬right.path <+: left.path ∧ ¬left.path <+: right.path := by
          have h := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h
          exact ⟨fun pre => by simpa [List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr pre] using h.1,
            fun pre => by simpa [List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr pre] using h.2⟩
        exact ⟨h.2,h.1⟩
      · exact ih disjoint.2 leftTail rightMem

private def Consistent (entries : List Entry) : Prop :=
  ∀ path, Entry.negative path ∈ entries → ¬Covers entries path

private theorem disjoint_consistent {entries : List Entry}
    (disjoint : entriesDisjoint entries = true) : Consistent entries := by
  intro path member ⟨entry, entryMember, cover⟩
  by_cases same : entry = .negative path
  · subst entry
    rcases cover with ⟨_, lt⟩ | ⟨_, impossible, _⟩
    · exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ lt
    · contradiction
  · have pairs := disjoint_pair disjoint member entryMember (Ne.symm same)
    rcases cover with ⟨pre, _⟩ | ⟨_, rfl, pre⟩
    · exact pairs.1 pre
    · exact pairs.2 pre

theorem ViewType.WellFormed.pos_not_neg {classes : ClassTable} {ty : ViewType}
    (wf : ty.WellFormed classes) {path : Path} (known : Pos classes ty path) : ¬Neg ty path := by
  intro negative
  have member := List.contains_iff_mem.mp negative
  obtain ⟨_, root | cover⟩ := pos_iff.mp known
  · subst path
    have valid := List.all_eq_true.mp wf.2.1 (.negative []) member
    simp [Entry.valid] at valid
  · exact disjoint_consistent wf.2.2 path member cover

private theorem selected_consistent {entries : List Entry} {field : FieldName}
    (consistent : Consistent entries) :
    Consistent (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])) := by
  intro path member cover
  exact consistent _ (selected_negative member) (selected_covers cover)

private theorem normalized_negative {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {fuel : Nat} {name : ClassName} {entries : List Entry} {path : Path}
    (consistent : Consistent entries)
    (noRoot : Entry.negative [] ∉ entries)
    (valid : (classAt classes name path).isSome = true)
    (member : Entry.negative path ∈ entries) :
    Entry.negative path ∈ normalizeEntries classes fuel name entries := by
  have nonempty : path ≠ [] := by intro eq; subst path; exact noRoot member
  induction fuel generalizing name entries path with
  | zero =>
    rw [normalizeEntries]
    split
    next whole =>
      have root := List.contains_iff_mem.mp whole
      exact False.elim (consistent path member ⟨.positive [], root,
        Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩⟩)
    next =>
      split
      · exact member
      · split
        next empty =>
          have emptyEntries := List.isEmpty_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp empty).2
          simp [emptyEntries] at member
        · exact member
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [normalizeEntries]
    split
    next whole =>
      have root := List.contains_iff_mem.mp whole
      exact False.elim (consistent path member ⟨.positive [], root,
        Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩⟩)
    next notWhole =>
      split
      · exact member
      next declaration found =>
        split
        next empty =>
          have emptyEntries := List.isEmpty_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp empty).2
          simp [emptyEntries] at member
        next notEmpty =>
          dsimp only
          split
          next complete =>
            have normalizedWhole : normalizeEntries classes (fuel+1) name entries = [.positive []] := by
              rw [normalizeEntries]
              simp only [notWhole, found]
              simp only [notEmpty]
              exact ite_eq_left complete
            have outputPos : Pos classes ⟨name, normalizeEntries classes (fuel+1) name entries⟩ path := by
              rw [normalizedWhole]
              exact pos_iff.mpr ⟨valid, Or.inr ⟨.positive [], by simp,
                Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩⟩⟩
            have inputPos := pos_iff.mp (normalizeEntries_pos classesWF outputPos)
            exact False.elim (consistent path member (inputPos.2.resolve_left nonempty))
          next =>
            cases path with
            | nil => contradiction
            | cons field rest =>
              cases targetFound : declaration.fields.lookup field with
              | none => simp [classAt, found, targetFound] at valid
              | some target =>
                have targetMember : (field, target) ∈ declaration.fields := by
                  obtain ⟨before, after, eq, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp targetFound
                  simp [eq]
                apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
                refine ⟨(field,target), targetMember, ?_⟩
                dsimp only
                have selected : Entry.negative rest ∈ entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field]) := by
                  exact List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨.negative (field::rest), member, by simp⟩
                split
                next empty =>
                  have empty := List.isEmpty_iff.mp empty
                  simp [empty] at selected
                next =>
                  split
                  next root =>
                    have root := List.contains_iff_mem.mp root
                    by_cases restEmpty : rest = []
                    · simp [restEmpty]
                    · have cover : Covers (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])) [] :=
                        ⟨.negative rest, selected, Or.inl ⟨by simp, List.length_pos_iff.mpr restEmpty⟩⟩
                      exact False.elim (selected_consistent consistent [] root cover)
                  next noRootSelected =>
                    apply List.mem_map.mpr
                    refine ⟨.negative rest, ?_, rfl⟩
                    apply ih (selected_consistent consistent)
                    · exact fun h => noRootSelected (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr h)
                    · simpa [classAt, found, targetFound] using valid
                    · exact selected
                    · intro eq; subst rest
                      exact noRootSelected (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr selected)

 theorem normalize_neg_iff {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {ty : ViewType} (wf : ty.WellFormed classes) (path : Path) :
    Neg (normalize classes ty) path ↔ Neg ty path := by
  constructor
  · exact normalize_neg
  · intro negative
    have member := List.contains_iff_mem.mp negative
    apply List.contains_iff_mem.mpr
    apply normalized_negative classesWF (disjoint_consistent wf.2.2)
    · intro root
      have valid := List.all_eq_true.mp wf.2.1 (.negative []) root
      simp [Entry.valid] at valid
    · have valid := List.all_eq_true.mp wf.2.1 (.negative path) member
      exact (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp valid).1
    · exact member

private theorem normalizeEntries_nonempty_of_positive {classes : ClassTable} {fuel : Nat}
    {name : ClassName} {entries : List Entry} {path : Path}
    (valid : (classAt classes name path).isSome = true)
    (member : Entry.positive path ∈ entries) :
    normalizeEntries classes fuel name entries ≠ [] := by
  induction fuel generalizing name entries path with
  | zero =>
    rw [normalizeEntries]
    split
    · simp
    · split
      · exact List.ne_nil_of_mem member
      · split
        · simp
        · exact List.ne_nil_of_mem member
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [normalizeEntries]
    split
    · simp
    next notWhole =>
      split
      · exact List.ne_nil_of_mem member
      next declaration found =>
        split
        · simp
        · dsimp only
          split
          · simp
          · cases path with
            | nil => exact False.elim (notWhole (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr member))
            | cons field rest =>
              cases targetFound : declaration.fields.lookup field with
              | none => simp [classAt, found, targetFound] at valid
              | some target =>
                have targetMember : (field,target) ∈ declaration.fields := by
                  obtain ⟨before, after, eq, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp targetFound
                  simp [eq]
                have selected : Entry.positive rest ∈ entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field]) :=
                  List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨.positive (field::rest), member, by simp⟩
                have selectedNonempty := List.ne_nil_of_mem selected
                intro empty
                have noMember := List.flatMap_eq_nil_iff.mp empty (field,target) targetMember
                dsimp only at noMember
                split at noMember
                next absent => exact selectedNonempty (List.isEmpty_iff.mp absent)
                next =>
                  split at noMember
                  · simp at noMember
                  · have noMember := List.map_eq_nil_iff.mp noMember
                    exact ih (by simpa [classAt, found, targetFound] using valid) selected noMember

private theorem covers_root {entries : List Entry} {path : Path} (cover : Covers entries path) :
    Covers entries [] := by
  obtain ⟨entry, member, covered⟩ := cover
  refine ⟨entry, member, ?_⟩
  rcases covered with ⟨_, lt⟩ | ⟨p, rfl, _⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨by simp, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) lt⟩
  · cases p with
    | nil => exact Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩
    | cons head tail => exact Or.inl ⟨by simp, by simp [Entry.path]⟩

private theorem selected_paths_valid {classes : ClassTable} {name : ClassName} {entries : List Entry}
    {field : FieldName} {declaration : TypedClass} {target : ClassName}
    (found : classes.lookup name = some declaration)
    (targetFound : declaration.fields.lookup field = some target)
    (valid : ∀entry ∈ entries, (classAt classes name entry.path).isSome = true) :
    ∀entry ∈ entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field]),
      (classAt classes target entry.path).isSome = true := by
  intro entry member
  obtain ⟨source, sourceMember, selected⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp member
  have eq := Entry.dropPrefix_eq_some selected
  subst source
  simpa [classAt, found, targetFound] using valid _ sourceMember

private theorem selected_covers_inv {entries : List Entry} {field : FieldName} {path : Path}
    (notWhole : Entry.positive [] ∉ entries) (cover : Covers entries (field :: path)) :
    Covers (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])) path := by
  obtain ⟨entry, member, covered⟩ := cover
  cases entry with
  | negative entryPath =>
    cases entryPath with
    | nil => rcases covered with ⟨pre, _⟩ | ⟨_, impossible, _⟩ <;> simp_all [Entry.path]
    | cons other rest =>
      rcases covered with ⟨pre, len⟩ | ⟨_, impossible, _⟩
      · have pre : field = other ∧ path <+: rest := by simpa [Entry.path] using pre
        obtain ⟨rfl, tailPre⟩ := pre
        exact ⟨.negative rest, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨_, member, by simp⟩,
          Or.inl ⟨tailPre, by simpa [Entry.path] using len⟩⟩
      · contradiction
  | positive entryPath =>
    cases entryPath with
    | nil => exact False.elim (notWhole member)
    | cons other rest =>
      have cover : Covers [Entry.positive (other :: rest)] (field :: path) :=
        ⟨_, by simp, covered⟩
      obtain ⟨same, selected⟩ := covers_cons_prepend_inv (entry := .positive rest) covered
      subst other
      obtain ⟨entry, singleton, covered⟩ := selected
      have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp singleton
      subst entry
      exact ⟨.positive rest, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨_, member, by simp⟩, covered⟩

private theorem covers_of_nonempty {entries : List Entry} (nonempty : entries ≠ [])
    (noRoot : Entry.negative [] ∉ entries) : Covers entries [] := by
  obtain ⟨entry, member⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ nonempty
  refine ⟨entry, member, ?_⟩
  cases entry with
  | positive path =>
    cases path with
    | nil => exact Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩
    | cons head rest => exact Or.inl ⟨by simp, by simp [Entry.path]⟩
  | negative path =>
    cases path with
    | nil => exact False.elim (noRoot member)
    | cons head rest => exact Or.inl ⟨by simp, by simp [Entry.path]⟩

private theorem normalized_positive {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {fuel : Nat} {name : ClassName} {entries : List Entry} {path : Path}
    (consistent : Consistent entries)
    (pathsValid : ∀entry ∈ entries, (classAt classes name entry.path).isSome = true)
    (known : Pos classes ⟨name, entries⟩ path) :
    Pos classes ⟨name, normalizeEntries classes fuel name entries⟩ path := by
  induction fuel generalizing name entries path with
  | zero =>
    rw [normalizeEntries]
    split
    · exact pos_iff.mpr ⟨known.valid, Or.inr ⟨.positive [], by simp, Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩⟩⟩
    · split
      · exact known
      · split
        · exact pos_iff.mpr ⟨known.valid, Or.inr ⟨.positive [], by simp, Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩⟩⟩
        · exact known
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [normalizeEntries]
    split
    · exact pos_iff.mpr ⟨known.valid, Or.inr ⟨.positive [], by simp, Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩⟩⟩
    next notWhole =>
      split
      · exact known
      next declaration found =>
        split
        · exact pos_iff.mpr ⟨known.valid, Or.inr ⟨.positive [], by simp, Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩⟩⟩
        · dsimp only
          split
          · exact pos_iff.mpr ⟨known.valid, Or.inr ⟨.positive [], by simp, Or.inr ⟨[], rfl, by simp⟩⟩⟩
          · cases path with
            | nil => exact Pos.root _ _
            | cons field rest =>
              have valid := known.valid
              cases targetFound : declaration.fields.lookup field with
              | none => simp [classAt, found, targetFound] at valid
              | some target =>
                have targetMember : (field,target) ∈ declaration.fields := by
                  obtain ⟨before, after, eq, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp targetFound
                  simp [eq]
                have cover : Covers entries (field::rest) := by
                  exact (pos_iff.mp known).2.resolve_left (by simp)
                have selectedCover := selected_covers_inv
                  (fun h => notWhole (List.contains_iff_mem.mpr h)) cover
                have selectedConsistent := selected_consistent (field := field) consistent
                have selectedNoRoot : Entry.negative [] ∉ entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field]) := by
                  intro negative
                  exact selectedConsistent [] negative (covers_root selectedCover)
                have selectedValid := selected_paths_valid found targetFound pathsValid
                have selectedPositive : Pos classes
                    ⟨target, entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])⟩ rest := by
                  refine pos_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Or.inr selectedCover⟩
                  simpa [classAt, found, targetFound] using valid
                have outputPositive := ih selectedConsistent selectedValid selectedPositive
                have outputNonempty : normalizeEntries classes fuel target
                    (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])) ≠ [] := by
                  obtain ⟨entry, member, _⟩ := selectedCover
                  cases entry with
                  | positive p => exact normalizeEntries_nonempty_of_positive (selectedValid _ member) member
                  | negative p =>
                    exact List.ne_nil_of_mem
                      (normalized_negative classesWF selectedConsistent selectedNoRoot (selectedValid _ member) member)
                have outputCover : Covers
                    (normalizeEntries classes fuel target (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field]))) rest := by
                  rcases (pos_iff.mp outputPositive).2 with root | cover
                  · subst rest
                    exact covers_of_nonempty outputNonempty
                      (fun h => selectedNoRoot (normalizeEntries_negative h))
                  · exact cover
                obtain ⟨entry, member, covered⟩ := (covers_prepend _ field rest).mpr outputCover
                refine pos_iff.mpr ⟨valid, Or.inr ⟨entry, ?_, covered⟩⟩
                apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
                refine ⟨(field,target), targetMember, ?_⟩
                dsimp only
                have selectedNonempty : (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])).isEmpty = false := by
                  apply List.isEmpty_eq_false_iff.mpr
                  obtain ⟨entry, member, _⟩ := selectedCover
                  exact List.ne_nil_of_mem member
                have noRootBool : (entries.filterMap (Entry.dropPrefix [field])).contains (.negative []) = false :=
                  Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr (fun h => selectedNoRoot (List.contains_iff_mem.mp h))
                simpa only [selectedNonempty, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, noRootBool] using member

theorem normalize_pos_iff {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {ty : ViewType} (wf : ty.WellFormed classes) (path : Path) :
    Pos classes (normalize classes ty) path ↔ Pos classes ty path := by
  constructor
  · exact normalize_pos classesWF
  · apply normalized_positive classesWF (disjoint_consistent wf.2.2)
    intro entry member
    exact (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (List.all_eq_true.mp wf.2.1 entry member)).1

end Dada.Unique.Typing
